name: Spinach & Feta Egg White Omelet
steps: Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and wilt the spinach for 1 minute.
Pour in the egg whites, season with pepper, and cook undisturbed until the edges set.
Sprinkle feta and green onion over one half, fold the omelet over and cook 1 more minute.
Slide onto a plate and serve immediately.

name: Veggie-Loaded Scrambled Eggs
steps: Sauté onion, bell pepper and mushrooms in olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add spinach and stir until wilted.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables and stir gently until softly set.
Fold in the cheddar, remove from heat and serve.

name: Avocado & Egg Sprouted-Grain Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and salt and spread over the toast.
Fry or poach the egg to your liking and set it on top.
Finish with red pepper flakes.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Parfait with Walnuts
steps: Spoon half the yogurt into a glass or bowl.
Layer half the berries and walnuts, then repeat with the remaining yogurt and toppings.
Sprinkle chia seeds and cinnamon on top and serve, or refrigerate up to 24 hours.

name: Overnight Steel-Cut Oats with Blueberries
steps: Combine oats, almond milk, chia seeds, cinnamon and vanilla in a jar and stir well.
Refrigerate overnight (at least 8 hours) so the oats soften without cooking, which keeps the GI lower.
In the morning stir, divide into two bowls and top with blueberries and sliced almonds.

name: Chia Seed Pudding with Raspberries
steps: Whisk chia seeds, almond milk, vanilla and sweetener in a bowl.
Let stand 10 minutes, whisk again to break up clumps, then refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Spoon into bowls and top with raspberries and sliced almonds.

name: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Peaches & Pecans
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Slice the peach and arrange on top.
Sprinkle with chopped pecans, ground flaxseed and cinnamon.

name: Southwest Breakfast Burrito
steps: Sauté onion and bell pepper in olive oil for 4 minutes, add black beans and cumin and warm through.
Whisk the eggs, pour into the pan and scramble until just set.
Warm the tortillas, fill with the egg mixture, cheese, avocado and salsa.
Roll tightly, folding in the sides, and cut in half.

name: Turkey Sausage & Kale Frittata
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Brown crumbled turkey sausage in an ovenproof skillet, then remove.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil, add kale and cook until wilted. Return sausage to the pan.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, pour over the filling and scatter mozzarella on top.
Cook 2 minutes on the stove, then bake 15–18 minutes until set. Cool 5 minutes before slicing.

name: Almond Flour Blueberry Pancakes
steps: Whisk eggs, almond milk, vanilla and sweetener, then stir in almond flour and baking powder to a thick batter.
Fold in the blueberries.
Cook 1/4-cup portions in coconut oil over medium-low heat, 3 minutes per side, flipping carefully.
Serve warm with extra berries if desired.

name: Shakshuka with Feta
steps: Sauté onion and bell pepper in olive oil over medium heat for 7 minutes, add garlic, cumin and paprika and cook 1 minute.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, season with salt and simmer 10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Make four wells, crack an egg into each, cover and cook 6–8 minutes until whites are set.
Top with crumbled feta and parsley and serve straight from the pan.

name: Smoked Salmon & Cream Cheese Egg Wrap
steps: Whisk eggs and cook in a lightly oiled nonstick pan as one thin round crepe-like layer, about 2 minutes.
Slide the egg wrap onto a plate and spread with cream cheese.
Layer smoked salmon, thin cucumber slices, capers and dill.
Roll up tightly and slice in half.

name: Peanut Butter Protein Smoothie
steps: Add almond milk, protein powder, peanut butter, spinach, banana and chia seeds to a blender.
Add a handful of ice and blend on high until completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink right away.

name: Green Power Smoothie
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend on high for 45–60 seconds until silky.
Adjust thickness with water and serve cold.

name: Mushroom & Swiss Omelet
steps: Sauté mushrooms in half the butter until browned, about 5 minutes; set aside.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, melt the remaining butter and pour in the eggs, tilting the pan as they set.
Add mushrooms and Swiss cheese to one side, fold and cook 1 minute more.
Garnish with chives.

name: Tomato, Basil & Mozzarella Egg Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and oil a 9-inch baking dish.
Whisk eggs, milk, garlic, salt and pepper; pour into the dish.
Scatter halved cherry tomatoes and torn mozzarella over the top.
Bake 25–30 minutes until puffed and set; top with torn basil before serving.

name: Egg Muffin Cups with Broccoli & Cheddar
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and oil a 12-cup muffin tin.
Steam finely chopped broccoli 2 minutes and divide among the cups with cheddar and green onion.
Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper and pour over the fillings.
Bake 20–22 minutes until set. Cool, then refrigerate up to 5 days or freeze.

name: Savory Oatmeal with Egg & Avocado
steps: Simmer oats in broth for 8–10 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Meanwhile fry the egg in olive oil until the white is set and yolk still runny.
Spoon oats into a bowl, top with the egg, sliced avocado, green onion and parmesan.
Add a dash of hot sauce.

name: Cinnamon Ricotta Bowl with Strawberries
steps: Whisk ricotta with vanilla, cinnamon and sweetener until fluffy.
Spoon into a bowl and top with sliced strawberries.
Sprinkle with chopped pistachios.

name: Huevos Rancheros with Black Beans
steps: Warm black beans with cumin and mash lightly.
Toast tortillas in a dry skillet until pliable and lightly charred.
Fry the eggs in olive oil until the whites are set.
Top each tortilla with beans, two eggs, warm salsa, avocado, cotija and cilantro.

name: Turkey Bacon, Egg & Cheese English Muffin
steps: Cook turkey bacon in a skillet until crisp; set aside.
Fry the egg in olive oil, breaking the yolk for a firmer sandwich.
Toast the English muffin and layer cheese, egg, bacon and tomato slices.
Close and serve warm.

name: Zucchini & Goat Cheese Frittata
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Sauté onion and grated zucchini in olive oil in an ovenproof skillet until moisture evaporates, 6 minutes.
Whisk eggs with thyme, salt and pepper and pour over the vegetables.
Dot with goat cheese and bake 15 minutes until just set.
Rest 5 minutes and cut into wedges.

name: Tofu Veggie Scramble
steps: Press the tofu and crumble it with your hands.
Sauté onion and bell pepper in olive oil for 4 minutes, add tofu, turmeric, garlic powder, salt and pepper and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in spinach and nutritional yeast and cook until wilted.
Serve hot with hot sauce if desired.

name: Salmon & Asparagus Egg Skillet
steps: Sauté chopped asparagus in olive oil for 4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add flaked salmon and green onion and warm through.
Pour in whisked eggs seasoned with salt and stir gently until softly scrambled.
Finish with dill and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Peanut Butter Chia Overnight Oats
steps: Stir oats, chia, almond milk, yogurt, peanut butter and cinnamon together in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with sliced strawberries before eating.

name: Breakfast Tacos with Eggs & Pico
steps: Whisk the eggs and scramble softly in olive oil.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill each with eggs, cheddar, pico de gallo, avocado and sliced jalapeño.
Top with cilantro and serve.

name: Cauliflower Hash Browns with Fried Eggs
steps: Microwave cauliflower rice 4 minutes, cool and squeeze dry in a clean towel.
Mix with 2 beaten eggs, parmesan, green onion, garlic powder and salt; form 4 patties.
Pan-fry in olive oil 4–5 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Fry the remaining 2 eggs and serve on top of the hash browns.

name: Denver Omelet
steps: Sauté diced ham, bell pepper and onion in olive oil for 4 minutes.
Pour in whisked, seasoned eggs and cook until nearly set.
Sprinkle cheddar over one half, fold and cook 1 minute more.
Slide onto a plate.

name: Apple Cinnamon Baked Oatmeal Cups
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a muffin tin.
Whisk eggs, almond milk, yogurt, vanilla and sweetener; stir in oats, cinnamon, baking powder, diced apple and walnuts.
Divide into 12 cups and bake 22–25 minutes until set.
Cool completely; keep refrigerated 5 days or freeze.

name: Lox Bagel Bowl (No Bagel)
steps: Spread cottage cheese in a shallow bowl.
Arrange smoked salmon, sliced cucumber, tomato and red onion on top.
Scatter capers, dill and everything seasoning and serve.

name: Egg & Veggie Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Sauté mushrooms and spinach in half the oil, add whisked eggs and scramble.
Place the tortilla in the pan, put cheese and eggs on one half and fold.
Cook 2 minutes per side in the remaining oil until crisp.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Pumpkin Spice Protein Oats
steps: Simmer oats, pumpkin puree and almond milk for 6–7 minutes, stirring.
Remove from heat and stir in protein powder, spice and sweetener.
Top with chopped pecans.

name: Caprese Egg Cups
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and oil 8 muffin cups.
Divide halved tomatoes, mozzarella and basil among the cups.
Pour in whisked eggs with milk and salt and bake 18–20 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes before removing.

name: Steak & Eggs with Sautéed Spinach
steps: Season the steak and sear in olive oil 3–4 minutes per side for medium; rest 5 minutes.
In the same pan, sauté garlic and spinach until wilted.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Slice the steak and serve with eggs and spinach.

name: Berry Kefir Smoothie
steps: Blend kefir, berries, flaxseed, protein powder and vanilla until smooth.
Add ice if you like it thicker.
Serve immediately.

name: Mediterranean Breakfast Plate
steps: Hard-boil the eggs (8 minutes), cool and halve.
Arrange eggs, cucumber, tomato, olives and feta on a plate.
Add hummus drizzled with olive oil and za'atar, and the warmed pita half on the side.

name: Cottage Cheese Egg Bites (Sous-Vide Style)
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and set a silicone muffin pan in a larger pan of hot water.
Blend eggs, cottage cheese, salt and pepper until smooth.
Divide chopped pepper, spinach and cheese among 8 cups and pour in the egg mixture.
Bake in the water bath 28–30 minutes until just set.

name: Sweet Potato & Turkey Breakfast Hash
steps: Cook diced sweet potato in olive oil over medium heat, covered, for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add onion, pepper and turkey; cook until browned, seasoning with paprika and salt.
Stir in kale until wilted. Make three wells and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook 5 minutes until the eggs are set.

name: Egg Salad Lettuce Wraps
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, cool, peel and chop.
Mix with yogurt, mayo, Dijon, celery, chives, salt and pepper.
Spoon into butter lettuce leaves and serve.

name: Coconut Almond Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk chia with both milks, vanilla and stevia; refrigerate overnight.
Toast coconut and almonds in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Top the pudding with blackberries and the toasted mix.

name: Spinach Mushroom Crustless Quiche
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and oil a 9-inch pie dish.
Sauté onion and mushrooms in olive oil until dry and golden, add spinach and wilt.
Whisk eggs, milk, yogurt, nutmeg and salt; stir in the vegetables and cheese and pour into the dish.
Bake 35–40 minutes until the center is set. Rest 10 minutes.

name: Protein Waffles (Oat & Cottage Cheese)
steps: Blend oats, cottage cheese, eggs, baking powder, vanilla and cinnamon into a smooth batter.
Cook in a preheated, lightly greased waffle iron until golden, about 4 minutes per waffle.
Serve with Greek yogurt and sliced strawberries.

name: Breakfast Salad with Poached Egg
steps: Poach the eggs in simmering water with a splash of vinegar for 3 minutes.
Toss greens with olive oil, lemon juice and salt.
Top with avocado, tomatoes, pumpkin seeds and the poached eggs.

name: Chorizo-Style Turkey Breakfast Skillet
steps: Mix turkey with chili powder, paprika, cumin, vinegar and salt to make a quick chorizo.
Brown the turkey mixture with onion and pepper in olive oil, breaking it up, about 10 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until set.
Sprinkle with cilantro.

name: Blueberry Cottage Cheese Pancakes
steps: Blend cottage cheese, eggs, oats, vanilla and baking powder until smooth.
Fold in blueberries and let batter rest 5 minutes.
Cook small pancakes in coconut oil over medium-low heat, 2–3 minutes per side.

name: Eggs Benedict on Portobello with Yogurt Hollandaise
steps: Brush portobellos with olive oil and roast at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Whisk yogurt, lemon juice, Dijon and melted butter for a quick hollandaise; warm gently.
Poach the eggs 3 minutes and sear the Canadian bacon.
Stack mushroom, bacon and egg, spoon sauce over and top with chives.

name: Almond Butter Banana Protein Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with almond butter and top with thin banana slices.
Sprinkle with hemp seeds and cinnamon.

name: Ham & Asparagus Egg White Frittata
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Sauté onion and asparagus pieces in oil in an ovenproof skillet for 4 minutes; add diced ham.
Whisk egg whites and eggs with pepper, pour over and sprinkle with parmesan.
Bake 15 minutes until set; slice into wedges.

name: Chocolate Avocado Protein Smoothie
steps: Combine everything in a blender.
Blend until creamy and thick.
Serve immediately.

name: Bacon, Egg & Avocado Breakfast Bowl
steps: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble.
Fry the eggs in a little of the bacon fat or olive oil.
Fill a bowl with arugula, tomatoes and sliced avocado; add eggs and bacon and season.

name: Buckwheat Porridge with Cherries & Almonds
steps: Warm cooked buckwheat with almond milk, cinnamon and vanilla until creamy, 5 minutes.
Divide into bowls.
Top with pitted cherries and sliced almonds.

name: Egg-in-a-Hole Avocado
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Halve the avocado and scoop out a little flesh to enlarge the cavities.
Set halves in a small dish, crack an egg into each and season.
Bake 12–15 minutes until whites are set; top with cheddar for the last 2 minutes.
Garnish with chives and hot sauce.

name: Veggie Breakfast Bowl with Quinoa
steps: Sauté kale in olive oil until tender; season and add lemon juice.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Divide quinoa between bowls, add kale, tomatoes, avocado and feta, and top with eggs.

name: Smoked Trout & Egg Breakfast Board
steps: Poach or bake trout fillet (or use smoked trout), then flake.
Hard-boil eggs, cool and halve.
Arrange trout, eggs, rye bread, cucumber and radish slices on a board with a bowl of yogurt mixed with dill, lemon and pepper.

name: Cinnamon Apple Cottage Cheese Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with cottage cheese and top with thin apple slices.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and chopped walnuts.

name: Kale & White Bean Breakfast Skillet
steps: Sauté garlic and red pepper flakes in olive oil 30 seconds, add kale and cook until wilted.
Stir in beans, lemon juice and salt; heat through.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5–6 minutes.
Top with parmesan.

name: Turkey & Avocado Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Toast the bread and fry the egg in olive oil.
Spread Dijon on one slice, mash avocado on the other.
Layer turkey, tomato and the egg; close the sandwich.

name: Matcha Chia Protein Pudding
steps: Whisk almond milk with protein powder, matcha, vanilla and sweetener until no lumps remain.
Stir in chia seeds, rest 10 minutes, stir again and refrigerate 4+ hours.
Top with diced kiwi.

name: Mexican Egg White Scramble with Salsa Verde
steps: Warm black beans with cumin in olive oil.
Add egg whites and stir gently until set.
Top with salsa verde, cotija and cilantro.

name: Sardine & Avocado Toast
ing: Sardines, canned in olive oil, drained
steps: Toast the rye bread.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and spread on the toast.
Top with sardines, thin red onion, parsley and pepper flakes.

name: Greek Yogurt Protein Bowl with Pomegranate
steps: Stir stevia into the yogurt if desired.
Top with pomegranate arils, pistachios and hemp seeds.
Garnish with torn mint.

name: Egg & Turkey Sausage Breakfast Skillet Pizza
steps: Brown the sausage with pepper and mushrooms in an ovenproof skillet.
Pour in whisked eggs with Italian seasoning; cook until the bottom sets.
Spread marinara over the top, add mozzarella and broil 3–4 minutes until bubbly.
Slice like a pizza.

name: Farro Breakfast Bowl with Pear & Walnuts
steps: Warm cooked farro with almond milk, cinnamon and vanilla for 5 minutes.
Divide into bowls and add a spoon of Greek yogurt.
Top with diced pear and walnuts.

name: Cheesy Cauliflower Breakfast Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Steam cauliflower florets 5 minutes and spread in an oiled 9x13 dish.
Cook turkey bacon until crisp and crumble over the cauliflower.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt and pepper; pour over, top with cheddar and green onion.
Bake 30–35 minutes until golden and set.

name: Strawberry Almond Overnight Oats
steps: Stir oats, almond milk, yogurt, chia and vanilla in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with sliced strawberries and a drizzle of almond butter.

name: Crab & Avocado Omelet
steps: Whisk eggs with Old Bay and cook in olive oil until nearly set.
Add crab and green onion to one half, fold and cook 1 minute.
Top with sliced avocado and lemon juice.

name: Cinnamon Flax Microwave Muffin
steps: Mix flaxseed, egg, baking powder, cinnamon, sweetener and melted coconut oil in a mug.
Microwave 90 seconds until set.
Turn out, split and serve with Greek yogurt and raspberries.

name: Breakfast Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Halve peppers lengthwise and remove seeds; bake 10 minutes.
Brown sausage and wilt spinach together.
Fill the pepper halves with sausage-spinach mix, pour in whisked eggs, top with cheddar.
Bake 18–20 minutes until eggs are set.

name: Tempeh Bacon, Lettuce & Tomato Wrap
steps: Slice tempeh thin and marinate 5 minutes in tamari, paprika and maple syrup.
Pan-fry in olive oil 3 minutes per side until crisp.
Fill tortillas with lettuce, tomato, avocado and tempeh bacon; roll up.

name: Salmon Cakes with Poached Eggs
steps: Mix salmon, 1 egg, almond flour, green onion, Dijon and lemon juice; form 4 patties.
Pan-fry in olive oil 4 minutes per side until golden.
Poach the remaining 2 eggs.
Serve cakes on arugula topped with a poached egg.

name: Pesto Egg Toast
steps: Heat pesto in a nonstick pan and crack in the eggs; fry until whites set.
Toast the bread.
Slide the pesto eggs onto the toast and top with halved tomatoes and parmesan.

name: Blackberry Ricotta Protein Crepes
steps: Blend eggs, egg whites, almond milk, oat flour and vanilla into a thin batter.
Cook thin crepes in a lightly oiled pan, 1 minute per side; makes about 6.
Mix ricotta with sweetener, fill crepes, fold and top with blackberries.

name: Miso Egg Drop Breakfast Soup
steps: Bring broth with ginger to a simmer; add cubed tofu and spinach.
Whisk miso with a ladle of hot broth and stir back in (do not boil).
Slowly pour in beaten eggs while stirring to form ribbons.
Top with green onion and torn nori.

name: Zucchini Bread Protein Oatmeal
steps: Simmer oats, grated zucchini and almond milk 5 minutes.
Whisk in egg whites while stirring quickly to thicken and add protein; cook 1 minute.
Stir in spices, vanilla and sweetener; top with walnuts.

name: Loaded Veggie Egg White Wrap
steps: Sauté mushrooms and spinach in olive oil 3 minutes.
Add egg whites and scramble until set; stir in roasted pepper and feta.
Spoon into the warmed tortilla and roll up.

name: Cherry Vanilla Protein Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend frozen cherries, yogurt, protein powder, almond milk and vanilla until thick.
Spoon into a bowl.
Top with chia seeds, sliced almonds and coconut.

name: Corned-Beef-Style Brisket Hash with Cabbage
steps: Sauté onion, pepper and shredded cabbage in olive oil until softened and browned in spots, 8 minutes.
Add shredded cooked beef and Dijon; press down and crisp 4 minutes.
Fry eggs and serve on top of the hash.

name: Golden Turmeric Scramble with Chickpeas
steps: Sauté onion in olive oil with turmeric and cumin for 3 minutes.
Add chickpeas and spinach; cook until spinach wilts.
Pour in whisked eggs and scramble softly. Season and garnish with cilantro.

name: Egg White & Turkey Bacon Power Bowl
steps: Cook turkey bacon until crisp and chop.
Wilt spinach in olive oil, add egg whites and scramble.
Assemble in a bowl with tomatoes and avocado; sprinkle with everything seasoning.

name: Apple Pie Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk chia, almond milk, sweetener, vanilla and half the cinnamon; refrigerate overnight.
Sauté diced apple with the remaining cinnamon and nutmeg for 4 minutes until soft.
Top the pudding with warm apple and walnuts.

name: Herbed Goat Cheese Scramble on Rye
steps: Whisk eggs with pepper and cook in butter over low heat, stirring for soft curds.
Fold in goat cheese and herbs off the heat.
Serve over toasted rye.

name: Sausage & Egg Cauliflower Breakfast Burrito Bowl
steps: Sauté cauliflower rice with cumin in half the oil 5 minutes; season and divide into bowls.
Brown sliced sausage, add beans and warm through.
Scramble the eggs in the remaining oil.
Top the cauliflower with sausage, beans, eggs, cheddar, salsa, avocado and cilantro.

name: Peach Cottage Cheese Smoothie
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Add ice for a thicker texture.
Pour and serve.

name: Eggplant & Egg Sabich-Style Plate
steps: Slice eggplant into rounds, brush with olive oil and salt, and roast at 425°F for 18 minutes.
Hard-boil the eggs and slice.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and a little water.
Plate eggplant, eggs, hummus, chopped tomato-cucumber salad and drizzle with tahini sauce.

name: Bulgur Breakfast Bowl with Yogurt & Berries
steps: Warm cooked bulgur with cinnamon.
Divide into bowls and top with Greek yogurt.
Add berries, pistachios and a small drizzle of honey.

name: Shrimp & Grits-Style Cauliflower Bowl
steps: Simmer cauliflower rice with milk 8 minutes, mash lightly and stir in cheddar for creamy 'grits'.
Cook turkey bacon until crisp; chop.
Sauté shrimp with garlic and Cajun seasoning in olive oil 3 minutes; add lemon juice.
Serve shrimp over the cauliflower grits with bacon and green onion.

name: Nut Butter & Berry Yogurt Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with Greek yogurt and dot with almond butter.
Top with raspberries and chia seeds.

name: Southwestern Sweet Potato Egg Boats
steps: Boil whole sweet potatoes 20–25 minutes until tender (boiling keeps the GI far lower than baking); cool slightly.
Split, scoop out some flesh to make a well; fill with beans and cumin.
Crack an egg into each, top with cheddar and bake 12 minutes until set.
Serve with salsa, avocado and cilantro.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Egg White Bites
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and oil a muffin tin.
Blend egg whites with cottage cheese, salt and onion powder.
Divide chopped steamed broccoli and cheddar among cups, pour in the mixture.
Bake 18–20 minutes.

name: Turkish Menemen
steps: Soften onion and pepper in olive oil 6 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook down 6 minutes into a thick sauce; season.
Pour in beaten eggs and stir slowly until soft-set.
Top with feta, parsley and pepper flakes.

name: Oat Bran Porridge with Walnuts & Cinnamon
steps: Simmer oat bran and almond milk, stirring, 3–4 minutes until thick.
Stir in cinnamon and flaxseed.
Top with walnuts and blueberries.

name: Greek Egg & Spinach Pita Pocket
steps: Wilt spinach in olive oil, add whisked eggs with oregano and scramble.
Warm the pita and split open.
Stuff with eggs, feta, tomato and chopped olives.

name: Blueberry Lemon Protein Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line 12 muffin cups.
Whisk eggs, yogurt, melted coconut oil, lemon zest and juice; stir in almond flour, protein, baking powder and sweetener.
Fold in blueberries and divide among cups.
Bake 20–22 minutes; cool before storing.

name: Wild Mushroom & Thyme Scramble
steps: Sear mushrooms in olive oil over high heat until browned, 5 minutes; add garlic and thyme.
Lower heat, add whisked eggs and scramble gently.
Finish with parmesan and salt.

name: Cinnamon Roll Overnight Oats
steps: Stir oats, almond milk, half the yogurt, cinnamon, vanilla and sweetener; refrigerate overnight.
Whip cream cheese with the remaining yogurt for a 'frosting'.
Swirl the frosting over the oats and top with pecans.

name: Egg Foo Young Breakfast Patties
steps: Mix eggs with sprouts, green onion, chopped mushrooms, chopped shrimp, tamari and sesame oil.
Ladle 1/2-cup portions into a hot oiled skillet and cook 3 minutes per side.
Serve with extra tamari.

name: Hemp Seed Protein Porridge
steps: Combine hemp, flax, chia and almond milk in a small pot.
Simmer 3–4 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Add cinnamon and stevia; top with blackberries.

name: Ham & Cheese Egg Roll-Ups
steps: Cook eggs as two thin omelets in olive oil.
Spread each with Dijon, layer ham, cheese and spinach.
Roll up tightly, slice into pinwheels.

name: Walnut Yogurt with Cinnamon Apples
steps: Sauté diced apple in butter with cinnamon 4 minutes until tender.
Stir vanilla into the yogurt.
Top with warm apples and walnuts.

name: Southwest Tofu Breakfast Tacos
steps: Crumble tofu and cook in olive oil with taco seasoning 6 minutes until golden.
Warm beans and tortillas.
Fill tortillas with tofu, beans, avocado, salsa, cilantro and lime.

name: Egg White Oatmeal Bowl with Almond Butter
steps: Cook oats in almond milk 4 minutes.
Whisk in egg whites vigorously and cook 2 more minutes until fluffy.
Top with almond butter, cinnamon and raspberries.

name: Asparagus, Prosciutto & Parmesan Baked Eggs
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss asparagus with olive oil in a baking dish and roast 8 minutes.
Nestle in torn prosciutto, crack eggs over the top and sprinkle with parmesan.
Bake 7–8 minutes until whites set; finish with pepper and lemon zest.

name: Sunrise Veggie Egg White Frittata Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and oil 12 muffin cups.
Whisk egg whites and eggs with salt; stir in grated zucchini, halved tomatoes, spinach, feta and basil.
Fill cups and bake 18–20 minutes until set.

name: Almond Joy Chia Overnight Oats
steps: Stir oats, chia, almond milk, cocoa, sweetener and yogurt in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with coconut and chopped almonds.

name: Cajun Shrimp Omelet
steps: Sauté shrimp and pepper with Cajun seasoning in olive oil 3 minutes; remove.
Cook whisked eggs until nearly set, add shrimp mix and cheese, fold.
Garnish with green onion.

name: Pear & Walnut Cottage Cheese Bowl
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with sliced pear, walnuts and hemp seeds.
Dust with cinnamon.

name: Spinach Artichoke Egg Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and oil a baking dish.
Whisk eggs, milk, softened cream cheese, garlic and salt.
Stir in chopped spinach, artichokes and mozzarella; pour into the dish.
Bake 30–35 minutes until set.

name: Turkey Sausage Breakfast Bowl with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown sausage; remove. Sauté cauliflower rice and kale in olive oil 5 minutes; season.
Fry the eggs.
Bowl the cauliflower-kale, sausage, eggs, avocado and hot sauce.

name: Raspberry Almond Protein Pancakes
steps: Whisk eggs, yogurt and vanilla; stir in almond flour, protein and baking powder.
Cook small pancakes in coconut oil 2–3 minutes per side.
Top with raspberries.

name: Everything Bagel Cucumber Cream Cheese Bites
steps: Slice cucumber into thick rounds.
Top each with cream cheese and a piece of smoked salmon.
Sprinkle with everything seasoning and chives.

name: Cheddar Jalapeño Egg Skillet
steps: Sauté jalapeño and green onion in olive oil 2 minutes.
Add whisked eggs, cook until half set, stir in tomato and cheddar.
Finish under the broiler 2 minutes; top with cilantro.

name: Orange Cardamom Yogurt Bowl
steps: Stir cardamom into the yogurt.
Top with orange segments, pistachios and chia.
Garnish with mint.

name: Lentil & Egg Breakfast Bowl
steps: Warm lentils with cumin, olive oil, lemon and salt; stir in spinach until wilted.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Serve lentils topped with eggs, yogurt and parsley.

name: Cocoa Peanut Butter Overnight Oats
steps: Mix oats, almond milk, cocoa, chia and sweetener in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with peanut butter and sliced strawberries.

name: Greek Chicken Sausage Skillet with Eggs
steps: Brown sliced sausage in olive oil; add zucchini and cook 4 minutes.
Add tomatoes, olives and oregano; cook 2 minutes.
Crack eggs over, cover and cook 5 minutes; top with feta.

name: Toasted Coconut Quinoa Porridge
steps: Warm cooked quinoa with coconut milk, cinnamon and stevia 5 minutes.
Toast coconut in a dry pan.
Top porridge with blueberries, almonds and coconut.

name: Bacon & Brussels Sprout Hash with Eggs
steps: Cook bacon until crisp; remove and crumble.
Sauté shredded sprouts and onion in the pan with olive oil until browned, 8 minutes; add vinegar.
Make wells, crack in eggs, cover and cook 5 minutes; top with bacon.

name: Salmon Avocado Sushi Breakfast Bowl
steps: Season cooled cauliflower rice with rice vinegar.
Top with salmon, avocado, cucumber, torn nori and a halved soft-boiled egg.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and drizzle with tamari.

name: Cranberry Orange Baked Oatmeal
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F; oil an 8x8 dish.
Whisk eggs, almond milk, orange zest and juice, vanilla and sweetener; stir in oats, baking powder, cinnamon, cranberries and pecans.
Bake 30–35 minutes until golden. Cut into squares.

name: Egg White Veggie Pizza Omelet
steps: Sauté mushrooms and pepper in olive oil.
Pour in egg whites with Italian seasoning; cook until set.
Spread marinara on top, add mozzarella and broil 2 minutes.

name: Keto Almond Flour Waffles
steps: Whisk eggs, almond milk, melted butter, vanilla and sweetener; stir in almond flour and baking powder.
Cook in a hot waffle iron 4 minutes until crisp.
Top with yogurt and blackberries.

name: Sweet Corn & Poblano Egg Skillet
steps: Char poblano and onion in olive oil 5 minutes; add corn and cook 2 minutes.
Add whisked eggs and scramble softly.
Top with cotija, cilantro and lime.

name: Kimchi Fried Cauliflower Rice with Egg
steps: Stir-fry cauliflower rice in avocado oil 4 minutes; add chopped kimchi and tamari and cook 3 minutes.
Push aside, scramble 2 eggs in the pan and mix through; add sesame oil.
Fry remaining 2 eggs and serve on top with green onion and sesame seeds.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Protein Oatmeal
steps: Cook oats in almond milk 5 minutes.
Off heat stir in protein powder and chia.
Top with sliced banana, peanut butter and cinnamon.

name: Italian Sausage & Pepper Egg Muffins
steps: Brown crumbled sausage with pepper and onion.
Divide among 12 oiled muffin cups with mozzarella.
Pour in whisked eggs with seasoning and bake at 350°F for 20 minutes.

name: Mango Coconut Chia Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice until smooth.
Let sit 5 minutes so chia thickens.
Serve cold.

name: Loaded Veggie Omelet with Avocado
steps: Sauté onion, mushrooms and chopped broccoli 5 minutes.
Add whisked eggs with salt and cook until set; add tomato, fold.
Top with sliced avocado.

name: Protein Cottage Cheese Toast with Tomato
steps: Toast the bread and spread with cottage cheese.
Top with tomato slices and basil.
Drizzle with olive oil and pepper.

name: Chilaquiles Verdes with Eggs (Light)
steps: Cut tortillas into triangles, toss with half the oil and bake at 400°F 10 minutes until crisp.
Warm salsa verde in a skillet, toss in the chips to coat.
Fry eggs in the remaining oil.
Top chips with eggs, cotija, onion, avocado, cilantro and a dollop of yogurt.

name: Egg & Kale Breakfast Soup
steps: Simmer broth with garlic; add beans and kale and cook 5 minutes.
Crack eggs into the soup and poach 4 minutes.
Serve with parmesan, olive oil and lemon.

name: Blueberry Protein Smoothie
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Serve immediately.

name: Spinach & Ricotta Egg Roll-Up
steps: Wilt spinach and mix with ricotta, parmesan and nutmeg.
Cook eggs as a thin omelet in olive oil.
Spread with the ricotta mix and roll up.

name: Blackened Tilapia Breakfast Tacos
steps: Coat tilapia in Cajun seasoning and sear in olive oil 3 minutes per side; flake.
Scramble eggs.
Toss slaw with yogurt and lime juice.
Fill warm tortillas with fish, egg, slaw and cilantro.

name: Warm Lentil & Feta Breakfast Salad
steps: Warm lentils with olive oil, lemon and salt.
Toss with tomatoes, cucumber and parsley.
Top with feta and halved soft-boiled eggs.

name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Egg Cups
steps: Line 6 muffin cups with prosciutto slices.
Add a little chopped spinach, crack in an egg, top with parmesan and pepper.
Bake at 400°F for 12–15 minutes.

name: Carrot Cake Overnight Oats
steps: Mix oats, grated carrot, almond milk, yogurt, spices, vanilla and sweetener.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with walnuts.

name: Bean & Cheese Breakfast Bowl
steps: Warm beans with cumin and mash lightly.
Fry the eggs in olive oil.
Layer beans, eggs, cheddar, salsa, avocado and green onion in a bowl.

name: Avocado Egg Salad Toast
steps: Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Chop hard-boiled eggs and fold in with chives.
Pile onto toasted bread; sprinkle pepper flakes.

name: Cauliflower Oatmeal (Low-Carb Porridge)
steps: Simmer cauliflower rice in almond milk 5 minutes until tender.
Whisk in egg whites and flaxseed; cook 2 minutes stirring until thick.
Add cinnamon, vanilla, sweetener; top with pecans and raspberries.

name: Turkey Club Breakfast Lettuce Wraps
steps: Cook turkey bacon until crisp.
Spread romaine leaves with mayo; layer turkey, bacon, sliced egg, tomato and avocado.
Roll and eat.

name: Cardamom Pear Steel-Cut Oats
steps: Simmer steel-cut oats in water 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in almond milk, cardamom and cinnamon.
Top with diced pear, almonds and yogurt.

name: Southwest Egg White Breakfast Pizza on Tortilla
steps: Crisp the tortilla in a skillet with olive oil.
Scramble egg whites, spread over the tortilla with beans and salsa.
Top with cheese, broil 2 minutes, add green onion and slice.

name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad (Light Dressing)
steps: Season chicken, grill 6 minutes per side, rest and slice.
Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, mashed anchovies, garlic and olive oil into a dressing.
Toss romaine with dressing, top with chicken, parmesan, pepper and crumbled crackers.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
steps: Combine chickpeas, diced cucumber, halved tomatoes, thin red onion, olives and parsley.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano and salt; toss with the salad.
Fold in feta and chill 20 minutes before serving.

name: Cobb Salad with Avocado Ranch
steps: Cook chicken in olive oil, slice; hard-boil eggs; crisp turkey bacon.
Blend half the avocado with yogurt, ranch seasoning and lemon juice for the dressing.
Arrange romaine with rows of chicken, egg, bacon, remaining avocado, tomato and blue cheese; drizzle dressing.

name: Kale & Quinoa Power Salad with Lemon Tahini
steps: Massage chopped kale with a pinch of salt for 1 minute to soften.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice, garlic, water and salt into a smooth dressing.
Toss kale with quinoa, chickpeas, shredded carrot and cabbage; drizzle dressing and top with pumpkin seeds.

name: Tuna Niçoise Salad
steps: Boil potatoes until tender; blanch green beans 3 minutes; hard-boil eggs.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, Dijon and mashed anchovy.
Arrange greens, tuna, potatoes, beans, eggs, tomatoes and olives; drizzle with dressing.

name: Asian Chicken Chopped Salad
steps: Whisk tamari, rice vinegar, sesame oil, grated ginger and peanut butter into a dressing.
Toss shredded chicken, cabbages, carrot, edamame, green onion and cilantro.
Dress just before serving and top with sliced almonds.

name: Greek Salad with Grilled Shrimp
steps: Toss shrimp with oregano and half the olive oil; grill 2–3 minutes per side.
Combine romaine, cucumber, tomato, onion and olives.
Dress with remaining oil and vinegar; top with feta and shrimp.

name: Southwest Black Bean & Avocado Salad
steps: Combine beans, corn, diced pepper, tomatoes, red onion and cilantro.
Whisk lime juice, olive oil, cumin, chili powder and salt.
Toss, fold in diced avocado just before serving.

name: Salmon Avocado Salad with Dill Dressing
steps: Season salmon and roast at 400°F for 12 minutes; flake.
Whisk yogurt, dill, lemon juice and salt for the dressing.
Toss greens, cucumber and radish with olive oil; top with salmon, avocado and dressing.

name: Lentil Tabbouleh
steps: Finely chop parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber and green onion.
Combine with cooked lentils.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil and salt; rest 15 minutes.

name: Buffalo Chicken Salad
steps: Sear chicken in olive oil, slice and toss with hot sauce melted with butter.
Mix yogurt, crumbled blue cheese and lemon juice into a dressing.
Serve chicken over romaine, celery and carrot with the dressing.

name: Caprese Salad with White Beans
steps: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella; arrange on a platter with white beans.
Tuck basil leaves between slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic; season.

name: Steak Salad with Chimichurri
steps: Season steak and grill 4–5 minutes per side; rest 5 minutes and slice thin.
Blend parsley, cilantro, garlic, vinegar, olive oil, pepper flakes and salt into chimichurri.
Toss arugula, tomatoes and onion; top with steak and chimichurri.

name: Thai Peanut Slaw with Edamame
steps: Whisk peanut butter, lime juice, tamari, sesame oil, ginger and water until smooth.
Toss slaw, cabbage, edamame, pepper, green onion and cilantro.
Dress and top with chopped peanuts.

name: Shrimp Louie Salad
steps: Poach shrimp 3 minutes; chill.
Mix yogurt, mayo, tomato paste, lemon juice and hot sauce for Louie dressing.
Plate lettuce, shrimp, quartered eggs, tomato, cucumber and avocado; spoon dressing over.

name: Farro & Roasted Vegetable Salad
steps: Roast zucchini, pepper and onion tossed with half the oil at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Combine farro, roasted vegetables, tomatoes and arugula.
Dress with remaining oil, balsamic and salt; top with feta and basil.

name: Chicken Waldorf Salad (Yogurt Dressing)
steps: Dice chicken, apple and celery.
Mix yogurt, lemon juice, Dijon and salt; fold in chicken mix and walnuts.
Serve in butter lettuce cups.

name: Roasted Beet & Goat Cheese Salad
steps: Wrap beets in foil and roast at 400°F for 45 minutes; peel and slice.
Toss arugula with olive oil, balsamic and salt.
Top with beets, orange segments, goat cheese and walnuts.

name: Tuna & White Bean Salad
steps: Flake tuna and combine with beans, onion, celery, parsley and capers.
Dress with olive oil and lemon juice.
Serve over arugula.

name: Spinach Strawberry Salad with Grilled Chicken
steps: Grill seasoned chicken 6 minutes per side; slice.
Whisk olive oil, balsamic and Dijon.
Toss spinach, strawberries and onion with dressing; top with chicken, goat cheese and almonds.

name: Egg & Avocado Chopped Salad
steps: Hard-boil eggs; crisp turkey bacon.
Chop everything into small dice.
Toss with olive oil, lemon, Dijon and chives.

name: Moroccan Carrot & Chickpea Salad
steps: Shred carrots and combine with chickpeas, cilantro and mint.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, cumin, coriander, cinnamon and salt.
Toss and top with toasted almonds.

name: Seared Ahi Tuna Salad with Ginger Dressing
steps: Coat tuna in sesame seeds and sear in avocado oil 1 minute per side; slice.
Whisk tamari, rice vinegar, grated ginger and sesame oil.
Plate greens, cucumber, avocado and edamame; top with tuna and dressing.

name: Broccoli Crunch Salad with Turkey Bacon
steps: Cook turkey bacon until crisp; chop.
Mix yogurt, mayo, vinegar and sweetener.
Toss chopped raw broccoli, onion, seeds, cheddar and bacon with the dressing; chill 30 minutes.

name: Grilled Feta & Cucumber Salad
steps: Sear thick feta slices in a dry nonstick pan 2 minutes per side until golden.
Toss cucumber, tomatoes, olives and mint with olive oil, lemon and oregano.
Top with warm feta.

name: Chicken Shawarma Salad
steps: Marinate chicken in spices, garlic, half the lemon and oil for 15 minutes; sear 6 minutes per side and slice.
Whisk tahini, yogurt, remaining lemon and water to a sauce.
Serve chicken over romaine, tomato, cucumber and onion with sauce and parsley.

name: Wild Rice, Cranberry & Pecan Salad
steps: Combine wild rice, chopped cranberries, pecans, celery, green onion and parsley.
Whisk orange juice, zest, olive oil, vinegar and salt.
Toss and serve at room temperature.

name: Crab & Avocado Salad
steps: Gently mix crab with celery, onion, yogurt, Dijon, lemon and Old Bay.
Fold in diced avocado.
Serve in lettuce cups with chives.

name: Roasted Cauliflower & Chickpea Salad with Tahini
steps: Toss cauliflower and chickpeas with oil, cumin and paprika; roast at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Whisk tahini, lemon, garlic and water.
Serve warm over arugula with tahini sauce, parsley and pomegranate.

name: Turkey Taco Salad
steps: Brown turkey in olive oil with taco seasoning, 8 minutes.
Layer romaine, beans, tomatoes and turkey in bowls.
Top with cheddar, avocado, salsa, yogurt and cilantro.

name: Cucumber Dill Salmon Salad
steps: Mix salmon with yogurt, dill, onion, lemon juice and capers.
Slice cucumber thin and toss with pepper.
Serve salmon salad over greens and cucumber.

name: Italian Antipasto Salad
steps: Chop romaine, turkey, mozzarella, artichokes and peppers.
Toss with olives and chickpeas.
Dress with olive oil, vinegar and oregano.

name: Warm Brussels Sprout Salad with Bacon & Pecans
steps: Cook bacon until crisp; crumble. Sauté shallot and shredded sprouts in the pan with olive oil 6 minutes.
Whisk vinegar and Dijon into the pan.
Toss with pecans, bacon and parmesan.

name: Chicken & Avocado Salad with Cilantro Lime
steps: Mash half the avocado with lime juice, yogurt and salt.
Fold in shredded chicken, diced avocado, onion, jalapeño and cilantro.
Serve over romaine.

name: Quinoa Greek Salad
steps: Combine quinoa, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives and parsley.
Dress with olive oil, lemon, oregano and salt.
Fold in feta; chill.

name: Blackened Shrimp Caesar with Kale
steps: Toss shrimp in Cajun seasoning and sear in half the oil 2 minutes per side.
Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, garlic and remaining oil; massage into chopped kale.
Top with shrimp, parmesan and pumpkin seeds.

name: Arugula, Pear & Walnut Salad with Chicken
steps: Season and pan-sear chicken 6 minutes per side; slice.
Whisk oil, vinegar and Dijon.
Toss arugula and sliced pear with dressing; top with chicken, walnuts and blue cheese.

name: Edamame & Cucumber Sesame Salad
steps: Slice cucumber and radish thin.
Whisk rice vinegar, tamari, sesame oil and ginger.
Toss with edamame and green onion; sprinkle sesame seeds.

name: BBQ Chicken Chopped Salad (No-Sugar BBQ)
steps: Mix tomato paste, vinegar, paprika and sweetener into a quick BBQ sauce; brush over chicken and grill 6 minutes per side; slice.
Mix yogurt with ranch seasoning.
Toss romaine, beans, corn, tomatoes and cheddar; top with chicken and ranch.

name: Smoked Mackerel & Beet Salad
steps: Flake mackerel and slice cooked beets.
Mix yogurt, dill and lemon.
Arrange greens, beets, onion and mackerel; drizzle yogurt and olive oil.

name: Chopped Italian Chicken Salad
steps: Season and grill chicken; dice.
Chop romaine, cucumber, tomatoes and mozzarella.
Toss with chickpeas, basil and the oil-vinegar-seasoning dressing.

name: Spicy Tuna Poke Bowl over Greens
steps: Dice tuna and toss with tamari, sesame oil, sriracha and mayo.
Arrange greens, cucumber, avocado and edamame in bowls.
Top with tuna, green onion, sesame seeds and torn nori.

name: Roasted Sweet Potato & Kale Salad
steps: Roast diced sweet potato with half the oil, cinnamon and salt at 425°F for 22 minutes.
Massage kale with remaining oil, vinegar and Dijon.
Toss with sweet potato, chickpeas, pumpkin seeds and goat cheese.

name: Chicken Cabbage Crunch Salad
steps: Shred cabbage and carrot; slice green onion.
Whisk vinegar, oil, Dijon and sweetener.
Toss with chicken, almonds and seeds.

name: Lemon Herb Shrimp & Cucumber Salad
steps: Sauté shrimp with garlic in half the oil 3 minutes; cool slightly.
Toss cucumber, tomatoes, chickpeas, herbs with lemon and remaining oil.
Add shrimp and feta.

name: Autumn Chicken Salad with Apple & Pecans
steps: Grill chicken; slice.
Whisk oil, vinegar and Dijon.
Toss greens, apple, onion with dressing; top with chicken, pecans and cheddar.

name: Smashed Cucumber Salad with Tofu
steps: Smash cucumbers with the flat of a knife, cut into chunks and salt 5 minutes; drain.
Pan-fry tofu cubes in avocado oil until golden.
Toss cucumber and tofu with garlic, vinegar, tamari, sesame oil, chili crisp and cilantro.

name: Turkey, Cranberry & Walnut Salad
steps: Whisk olive oil, orange juice and vinegar.
Toss greens, celery, chopped cranberries with dressing.
Top with turkey, walnuts and goat cheese.

name: Mexican Street Corn-Style Chicken Salad
steps: Grill chicken; dice. Char corn in a dry skillet 4 minutes.
Mix yogurt, mayo, lime, chili powder.
Toss romaine, chicken, corn, jalapeño, cilantro with dressing; top with cotija.

name: Salmon Sushi Salad
steps: Roast salmon at 400°F 12 minutes; flake.
Whisk rice vinegar, tamari, sesame oil and ginger.
Toss greens, cucumber, avocado, carrot, edamame; top with salmon, nori strips and sesame.

name: Three-Bean Salad (No Sugar)
steps: Blanch green beans 3 minutes; cool.
Whisk vinegar, oil, Dijon, sweetener and salt.
Toss all beans, onion and parsley with dressing; marinate 1 hour.

name: Grilled Halloumi-Style Feta & Chickpea Salad
steps: Sear feta slices 2 minutes per side.
Toss chickpeas, arugula, tomatoes, cucumber and mint with lemon, oil and sumac.
Top with feta.

name: Tofu Sesame Ginger Salad
steps: Pan-fry tofu cubes in avocado oil until crisp.
Whisk tamari, vinegar, sesame oil and ginger.
Toss vegetables with dressing; top with tofu and almonds.

name: Chicken Pesto Zoodle Salad
steps: Sear chicken in olive oil; slice.
Toss raw zoodles with pesto.
Add tomatoes, mozzarella, chicken and pine nuts.

name: Shredded Chicken Kale Caesar
steps: Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, mashed anchovy, garlic and oil.
Massage dressing into chopped kale.
Top with chicken, parmesan and hemp seeds.

name: Fennel, Orange & Olive Salad with Sardines
ing: Sardines, canned in olive oil, drained
steps: Shave fennel thin; segment orange.
Toss with olives, onion, olive oil, lemon and parsley.
Top with sardines and pepper.

name: Cauliflower 'Potato' Salad
steps: Steam cauliflower florets 6–8 minutes until just tender; cool completely.
Mix yogurt, mayo, Dijon and salt.
Fold in cauliflower, chopped eggs, celery, onion and pickle; top with paprika and chives. Chill 1 hour.

name: Grilled Chicken Fattoush
steps: Grill seasoned chicken; slice. Toast pita until crisp and break into shards.
Whisk oil, lemon, sumac and garlic.
Toss lettuce, cucumber, tomato, radish, herbs with dressing; add chicken and pita.

name: Shrimp & Avocado Mango Salad
steps: Sauté shrimp with cumin 3 minutes; cool.
Toss mango, avocado, onion, jalapeño, cilantro with lime and oil.
Serve with shrimp over greens.

name: Lemony Lentil & Arugula Salad with Salmon
steps: Roast salmon at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Whisk lemon, olive oil and Dijon; toss with lentils, tomatoes, onion and parsley.
Serve on arugula with flaked salmon.

name: Chicken Larb Lettuce Salad
steps: Brown chicken in avocado oil, breaking it up, 8 minutes.
Off heat toss with shallot, lime juice, fish sauce, herbs, green onion and pepper flakes.
Serve in lettuce cups with cucumber.

name: Hearts of Palm 'Crab' Salad
steps: Shred hearts of palm with a fork.
Mix with celery, onion, yogurt, mayo, Dijon, Old Bay and lemon.
Serve in lettuce cups.

name: Tuna Avocado Salad Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Mash avocado with lemon and Dijon; fold in tuna, celery and onion.
Hollow out tomatoes.
Fill with tuna salad and top with chives.

name: Pomegranate Kale Salad with Chicken
steps: Grill chicken; slice.
Massage kale with oil, lemon, Dijon and honey.
Top with chicken, pomegranate, walnuts and feta.

name: Zucchini Ribbon Salad with Parmesan & Pine Nuts
steps: Shave zucchini into ribbons with a peeler.
Toss with lemon, olive oil, beans and basil.
Top with parmesan shavings, pine nuts and pepper.

name: Beef Taco Salad Bowl
steps: Brown beef with taco seasoning, drain.
Layer romaine, beans, tomato and beef.
Top with cheddar, avocado, salsa, yogurt and green onion.

name: Cucumber Tomato Feta Salad
steps: Chop cucumber and tomato; slice onion thin.
Toss with olives, oil, vinegar and oregano.
Top with feta.

name: Chicken & Farro Harvest Salad
steps: Grill chicken and dice.
Whisk oil, vinegar and Dijon; massage into chopped kale.
Toss with farro, apple, pecans, goat cheese and chicken.

name: Spicy Chickpea & Avocado Smash Salad
steps: Mash chickpeas and avocado together roughly.
Stir in lemon, hot sauce, cumin, celery, onion and cilantro.
Serve over romaine.

name: Seared Scallop Salad with Citrus Vinaigrette
steps: Pat scallops dry, sear in avocado oil 90 seconds per side.
Whisk olive oil, orange juice and Dijon.
Toss greens with dressing; top with grapefruit segments, avocado, scallops and chives.

name: Egg Salad Stuffed Avocados
steps: Hard-boil and chop eggs.
Mix with yogurt, Dijon, celery, chives and salt.
Halve avocados and fill; dust with paprika.

name: Turkey BLT Salad
steps: Crisp turkey bacon; chop.
Mix yogurt, mayo, lemon and chives.
Toss romaine, tomato, turkey, bacon and avocado with dressing.

name: Arugula, Fennel & Salmon Salad
steps: Roast salmon at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Shave fennel and segment orange.
Toss arugula, fennel, orange and olives with oil and lemon; top with salmon.

name: Buffalo Cauliflower & Chicken Salad
steps: Toss cauliflower in oil and half the hot sauce; roast at 425°F 22 minutes.
Mix yogurt, blue cheese, lemon and remaining hot sauce.
Toss romaine, celery, carrot, chicken and cauliflower with dressing.

name: Thai Beef Salad
steps: Grill steak 4 minutes per side; rest and slice thin.
Whisk lime, fish sauce and pepper flakes.
Toss greens, cucumber, tomato, onion, herbs and steak with dressing; top with peanuts.

name: Caprese Chicken Salad
steps: Grill chicken; slice.
Arrange greens, tomato, mozzarella and chicken.
Drizzle oil and balsamic; scatter basil.

name: Sesame Chicken Soba Salad
steps: Poach or grill chicken; shred.
Whisk tamari, vinegar, sesame oil and ginger.
Toss cold soba with chicken, vegetables and dressing; sprinkle sesame.

name: Cajun Shrimp & Avocado Corn Salad
steps: Sauté shrimp in oil with Cajun seasoning 3 minutes.
Char corn 3 minutes in the same pan.
Toss with avocado, tomato, onion, cilantro, lime; serve over romaine.

name: Greek Lentil Salad
steps: Combine lentils, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives and parsley.
Dress with oil, vinegar and oregano.
Fold in feta.

name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Chopped Salad
steps: Grill chicken and crisp bacon; chop.
Whisk yogurt, ranch seasoning and lemon.
Toss everything with the dressing.

name: Roasted Broccoli & Chickpea Salad
steps: Roast broccoli and chickpeas with oil, garlic and pepper flakes at 425°F 20 minutes.
Toss with lemon juice.
Top with parmesan and almonds; serve warm.

name: Shrimp Cobb Salad
steps: Sauté shrimp 3 minutes; crisp bacon; boil eggs.
Whisk oil, vinegar and Dijon.
Arrange all over romaine; drizzle dressing.

name: Cabbage & Apple Slaw with Pork Tenderloin
steps: Season pork and roast at 425°F 18–20 minutes; rest and slice.
Whisk yogurt, Dijon and vinegar.
Toss shredded cabbage, apple and carrot with dressing; serve with pork.

name: Miso-Ginger Salmon Salad
steps: Whisk miso, ginger, vinegar and sesame oil; brush half on salmon and roast at 400°F 12 minutes.
Toss greens, cucumber, edamame and radish with remaining dressing.
Top with salmon and sesame seeds.

name: Southwest Quinoa Salad with Grilled Chicken
steps: Grill chicken; dice.
Whisk lime, oil and cumin.
Toss quinoa, beans, pepper, corn, cilantro with dressing; top with chicken and avocado.

name: Tomato, Cucumber & Hemp Seed Salad
steps: Chop tomato and cucumber; slice onion.
Toss with oil, vinegar, dill and salt.
Sprinkle hemp seeds.

name: Chicken Souvlaki Salad
steps: Marinate chicken in lemon, oregano, garlic and half the oil; grill 6 minutes per side and slice.
Mix yogurt, dill and grated cucumber (a little) for tzatziki.
Toss salad vegetables with remaining oil; top with chicken, feta and tzatziki.

name: Winter Citrus & Avocado Salad with Shrimp
steps: Sauté shrimp 3 minutes; cool.
Segment citrus.
Toss greens with oil and lime; top with citrus, avocado, onion, shrimp, pistachios and mint.

name: Loaded Kale Salad with Chicken & Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Roast chickpeas with half the oil and paprika at 425°F 22 minutes.
Grill chicken; slice.
Massage kale with remaining oil, lemon and garlic; toss with tomatoes, chicken, chickpeas and parmesan.

name: Cold Sesame Zoodle Salad with Shrimp
steps: Sauté shrimp 3 minutes; cool.
Whisk tahini, tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger and a little water.
Toss zoodles and cucumber with sauce; top with shrimp, green onion and sesame.

name: Cottage Cheese Veggie Salad Bowl
steps: Chop vegetables.
Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl and surround with vegetables.
Drizzle oil, add seeds, dill and pepper.

name: Smoked Turkey & Apple Kale Salad
steps: Whisk oil, vinegar and Dijon; massage into kale.
Add sliced apple, turkey and cheddar.
Top with walnuts.

name: Mediterranean Tuna Stuffed Peppers Salad
steps: Mix tuna, chickpeas, cucumber, olives, feta, parsley with oil and lemon.
Halve and seed peppers.
Fill with the tuna mixture.

name: Pesto Chicken Pasta Salad (Chickpea Pasta)
steps: Cook pasta al dente; rinse cool.
Grill chicken; dice.
Toss pasta, chicken, tomatoes, mozzarella and arugula with pesto and lemon.

name: Ginger Carrot & Edamame Salad
steps: Shred carrot; slice cucumber.
Whisk ginger, vinegar, tamari and sesame oil.
Toss with edamame and green onion; top with sesame.

name: Chicken Gyro Bowl Salad
steps: Season chicken with oregano, garlic, lemon and oil; sear and slice.
Make tzatziki with yogurt, dill and grated cucumber.
Bowl romaine, tomato, cucumber, onion, chicken and tzatziki; serve with toasted pita half.

name: Marinated Mushroom & White Bean Salad
steps: Sauté mushrooms with garlic and thyme in oil 6 minutes.
Toss warm mushrooms with beans, balsamic and parsley.
Serve over arugula with parmesan.

name: Chili Lime Steak & Avocado Salad
steps: Rub steak with chili powder; sear 4 minutes per side; rest, slice.
Toss romaine, tomato, onion with lime and oil.
Top with steak, avocado, cotija, cilantro.

name: Salmon Caesar Salad
steps: Roast salmon at 400°F 12 minutes.
Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, anchovy, garlic and oil.
Toss romaine with dressing; top with salmon, parmesan and capers.

name: Radish, Cucumber & Dill Salad with Smoked Trout
steps: Slice radish and cucumber thin.
Mix yogurt, dill, lemon and oil.
Toss vegetables in dressing; top with flaked trout and rye croutons.

name: Spinach & Chickpea Salad with Tahini Dressing
steps: Whisk tahini, lemon, garlic and water.
Toss spinach, chickpeas, cucumber, tomato and onion.
Drizzle with dressing; sprinkle sumac.

name: Peach, Mozzarella & Prosciutto Salad
steps: Slice peach and mozzarella.
Arrange with prosciutto over arugula.
Drizzle oil and balsamic; add basil and pepper.

name: Chicken Cauliflower Tabbouleh
steps: Grill chicken; dice.
Pulse raw cauliflower rice with parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber and green onion.
Dress with lemon, oil and salt; fold in chicken.

name: Autumn Roasted Squash & Arugula Salad
steps: Roast diced squash with half the oil, cinnamon and salt at 425°F 22 minutes.
Toss arugula and chickpeas with remaining oil and balsamic.
Top with squash, seeds and goat cheese.

name: Shrimp & Hearts of Palm Ceviche Salad
steps: Poach shrimp 3 minutes, chop and chill.
Toss with hearts of palm, tomato, onion, cilantro, jalapeño, lime and salt; marinate 20 minutes.
Fold in avocado and oil.

name: Chicken Vegetable Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and celery in olive oil 6 minutes; add garlic.
Add broth, chicken, thyme, bay leaf and salt; simmer 20 minutes; remove chicken and shred.
Add green beans and zucchini, simmer 6 minutes; return chicken and finish with parsley.

name: Turkey Chili
steps: Brown turkey in olive oil with onion and pepper, 8 minutes; add garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes, beans, broth and salt; simmer uncovered 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve with Greek yogurt and cilantro if desired.

name: Red Lentil Soup with Lemon
steps: Sauté onion and carrot in oil 6 minutes; add garlic, cumin and turmeric.
Add dry lentils and broth; simmer 25 minutes until soft.
Blend partially, stir in lemon juice and salt; garnish with cilantro.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup (Lightened)
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add broccoli, cauliflower and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend two-thirds of the soup until smooth (cauliflower replaces flour as thickener).
Stir in milk, cheddar, Dijon and salt; heat gently without boiling.

name: Beef & Barley Soup
steps: Brown cubed beef in oil; remove. Sauté onion, carrot, celery and mushrooms 8 minutes.
Add tomato paste, garlic, broth, beef, thyme and bay leaf; simmer 60 minutes.
Add dry barley and simmer 30 minutes more until tender; season.

name: Tuscan White Bean & Kale Soup
steps: Brown sliced sausage in oil; add onion, carrot and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, beans and rosemary; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in kale until wilted; serve with parmesan.

name: Thai Coconut Chicken Soup (Tom Kha)
steps: Simmer broth with ginger, lemongrass and curry paste 10 minutes.
Add sliced chicken and mushrooms; cook 8 minutes.
Add coconut milk, fish sauce and lime; heat through. Top with cilantro, green onion and chili.

name: Black Bean Soup
steps: Sauté onion, pepper and garlic in oil with cumin and chili powder 6 minutes.
Add beans and broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend half the soup, stir back in with lime and salt; top with yogurt and cilantro.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup (No Chips)
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, jalapeño and garlic with spices in oil 5 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes and chicken; simmer 20 minutes; shred the chicken.
Add beans and heat; serve with avocado, cheddar, cilantro and lime.

name: Creamy Cauliflower Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend smooth with milk, nutmeg and salt; garnish with parmesan and chives.

name: Lentil Vegetable Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and celery in oil 7 minutes; add garlic and spices.
Add dry lentils, tomatoes and broth; simmer 30 minutes.
Stir in spinach and vinegar; season.

name: Italian Wedding Soup with Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix turkey, egg, half the parmesan, almond flour and seasoning; roll into small meatballs.
Sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic in oil; add broth and simmer.
Drop in meatballs, cook 12 minutes; add spinach and remaining parmesan.

name: Split Pea Soup with Ham
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and celery in oil 6 minutes; add garlic.
Add dry split peas, ham, broth, bay leaf and thyme; simmer 60–70 minutes until peas break down.
Remove bay leaf; season with pepper.

name: Egg Drop Soup with Tofu & Spinach
steps: Simmer broth with ginger and tamari; add tofu cubes.
Drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring slowly to make ribbons.
Add spinach, sesame oil and green onion.

name: Salmon Chowder (Cauliflower Base)
steps: Sauté onion, celery, carrot and garlic in oil 6 minutes.
Add cauliflower and broth; simmer 12 minutes. Blend half for creaminess.
Add salmon chunks and milk; simmer 6 minutes; finish with dill and lemon.

name: Minestrone with Chickpea Pasta
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery in oil 7 minutes; add garlic and seasoning.
Add tomatoes, broth, beans; simmer 15 minutes; add zucchini and green beans for 6 minutes.
Cook pasta separately and add to bowls; top with parmesan.

name: Chicken Zoodle Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery in oil; add garlic and thyme.
Add broth and chicken; simmer 20 minutes; shred chicken.
Add zoodles for 2 minutes; finish with parsley and lemon.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
steps: Sauté onion and carrot in oil 6 minutes; add garlic and spices 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, broth, chickpeas and harissa; simmer 20 minutes.
Add zucchini for 8 minutes; finish with lemon and cilantro.

name: Hearty Beef Stew with Root Vegetables
steps: Brown beef cubes in oil in batches; remove.
Sauté onion, celery, mushrooms; add tomato paste, garlic, wine and reduce 2 minutes.
Return beef with broth, thyme, bay leaf; simmer covered 90 minutes. Add carrot and turnip; cook 30 minutes more.

name: Gazpacho
steps: Roughly chop vegetables.
Blend with garlic, oil, vinegar, salt and cumin until smooth.
Chill 2 hours; serve cold.

name: Chicken & White Bean Chili
steps: Sauté onion and garlic with spices in oil 5 minutes.
Add broth, chicken, beans and chiles; simmer 25 minutes; shred chicken.
Mash a few beans to thicken; stir in yogurt, lime, cilantro and salt.

name: Miso Soup with Tofu & Wakame
steps: Simmer broth with sliced shiitake 5 minutes; add tofu and wakame.
Remove from heat; whisk miso with a little broth and stir in.
Top with green onion.

name: Roasted Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Roast halved tomatoes, onion and garlic with oil at 400°F for 35 minutes.
Blend with broth, white beans (for body and protein) and basil.
Simmer 5 minutes; season.

name: Shrimp & Sausage Gumbo (Light Roux-Free)
steps: Brown sausage in oil; add onion, pepper, celery and cook 8 minutes; add garlic.
Add tomatoes, broth, okra, Cajun seasoning and bay leaf; simmer 25 minutes.
Add shrimp for 4 minutes; serve over sautéed cauliflower rice with green onion.

name: Mushroom & Wild Rice Soup
steps: Sauté mushrooms in oil until browned; add onion, carrot, celery and garlic 5 minutes.
Add broth, thyme; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cooked wild rice and milk; heat; serve with parmesan.

name: Chicken Pho (Zoodle)
steps: Simmer broth with ginger, star anise, cinnamon and fish sauce 15 minutes; poach chicken in it 10 minutes; slice.
Strain broth over zoodles in bowls.
Top with chicken, sprouts, herbs, lime, jalapeño and green onion.

name: Curried Butternut & Lentil Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and curry powder in oil 5 minutes.
Add squash, dry lentils and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Blend, stir in coconut milk, lime and salt; garnish with cilantro.

name: Turkey Meatball & Vegetable Soup
steps: Mix turkey, egg, almond flour, garlic powder; form meatballs.
Sauté onion and carrot; add broth, tomatoes, seasoning; simmer.
Add meatballs 12 minutes; add zucchini and green beans 6 minutes; serve with parmesan.

name: Caldo de Pollo (Mexican Chicken Soup)
steps: Simmer chicken in broth with onion, garlic, cumin and salt 25 minutes; shred.
Add carrot, cabbage and zucchini; cook 10 minutes.
Serve with cilantro, lime, jalapeño and avocado.

name: Creamy Zucchini Basil Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add zucchini and cook 5 minutes.
Add broth and beans; simmer 12 minutes.
Blend with basil and lemon; season; top with parmesan.

name: Kimchi Tofu Stew (Sundubu-Style)
steps: Sauté kimchi and garlic in sesame oil 3 minutes.
Add broth, gochujang, mushrooms and zucchini; simmer 8 minutes.
Add tofu chunks; crack in eggs and cook 3 minutes; top with green onion.

name: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Simmer chicken with onion and carrot in broth 20 minutes; shred chicken.
Add cauliflower rice, cook 5 minutes.
Whisk eggs with lemon; temper with hot broth and stir in off heat (avgolemono); add dill and salt.

name: Vegetarian Three-Bean Chili
steps: Sauté onion, pepper and zucchini in oil 8 minutes; add garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes, beans, broth and cocoa; simmer 30 minutes.
Season and serve with yogurt or avocado.

name: Clam Chowder (Cauliflower-Thickened)
steps: Crisp turkey bacon; set aside. Sauté onion and celery in oil.
Add cauliflower, potato, broth, thyme; simmer 15 minutes; blend half.
Add clams and milk; heat 5 minutes; top with bacon and pepper.

name: Spicy Peanut Sweet Potato Stew
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and spices in oil 5 minutes.
Add sweet potato, tomatoes, broth and chickpeas; simmer 20 minutes.
Whisk in peanut butter, add spinach and lime; season.

name: Chicken Cabbage Soup
steps: Sauté onion and carrot in oil; add garlic and paprika.
Add broth, tomatoes and chicken; simmer 20 minutes; shred chicken.
Add cabbage and cook 8 minutes; finish with dill.

name: Cioppino (Seafood Stew)
steps: Sauté onion, fennel and garlic in oil 6 minutes; add pepper flakes and oregano.
Add wine, tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Add mussels, cod and shrimp; cover and cook 6 minutes until mussels open; finish with parsley.

name: Greens & Beans Soup with Turkey Sausage
steps: Brown sausage; add onion and garlic 4 minutes.
Add broth and beans; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in chard until wilted; finish with lemon and parmesan.

name: Carrot Ginger Soup
steps: Sauté onion, ginger and garlic in oil 5 minutes.
Add carrot, beans and broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend with coconut milk and lime; season.

name: Pork & Napa Cabbage Soup
steps: Brown pork with ginger and garlic; add tamari.
Add broth and shiitake; simmer 8 minutes.
Add cabbage and tofu; cook 5 minutes; finish with sesame oil and green onion.

name: Chickpea Noodle Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery in oil; add garlic, thyme, turmeric.
Add broth and chickpeas; simmer 12 minutes.
Add pasta and cook 6–7 minutes; finish with parsley and lemon.

name: Beef & Cabbage Soup
steps: Brown beef with onion in oil; add garlic and paprika.
Add broth, tomatoes, carrot and cabbage; simmer 25 minutes.
Finish with vinegar and salt.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and spices in oil 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, chicken and cauliflower; simmer 20 minutes; shred chicken.
Stir in yogurt off heat; garnish cilantro.

name: Asparagus & Leek Soup
steps: Sauté leek and garlic in oil 6 minutes.
Add asparagus, beans and broth; simmer 12 minutes.
Blend smooth with lemon; serve with yogurt and chives.

name: Hot & Sour Soup
steps: Simmer broth with shiitake, ginger, tamari and vinegar 8 minutes.
Add tofu strips; drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring.
Finish with sesame oil, pepper, sprouts and green onion.

name: Lamb & Chickpea Stew
steps: Brown lamb cubes in oil; remove. Sauté onion, carrot, garlic and spices 6 minutes.
Return lamb with tomatoes and broth; simmer covered 60 minutes.
Add chickpeas for 20 minutes; finish with lemon and cilantro.

name: Creamy Mushroom Soup (No Cream)
steps: Sear mushrooms in oil until browned; add onion, garlic, thyme; deglaze with wine.
Add cauliflower and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with milk; season.

name: Shrimp Coconut Curry Soup
steps: Fry curry paste and ginger 1 minute; add broth and coconut milk; simmer 5 minutes.
Add pepper, mushrooms and snap peas; cook 4 minutes.
Add shrimp 3 minutes; finish with fish sauce, lime and basil.

name: Southwest Turkey & Bean Soup
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper in oil; add garlic and spices.
Add beans, tomatoes, chiles, broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Finish with cilantro and lime.

name: French Onion Soup (Lightened, No Bread)
steps: Cook thinly sliced onions in oil and butter over medium-low heat 40 minutes until deeply caramelized.
Add garlic, thyme and wine; reduce; add broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Ladle into ovenproof bowls, top with Swiss cheese and broil until bubbling.

name: Cauliflower Leek Vichyssoise
steps: Sweat leeks in oil 6 minutes without browning.
Add cauliflower and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with milk and vinegar; chill or serve warm with chives.

name: Chicken Enchilada Soup
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Sauté onion and pepper in oil with cumin.
Add enchilada sauce, broth, chiles and chicken; simmer 20 minutes; shred chicken.
Add beans; serve with cheddar, yogurt and cilantro.

name: Lentil & Sausage Stew
steps: Brown sausage; add onion, carrot and garlic 5 minutes; add paprika.
Add lentils, tomatoes and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in spinach and vinegar.

name: Chilled Cucumber Avocado Soup
steps: Blend cucumber, avocado, yogurt, lime, dill, garlic, water and salt until smooth.
Chill 1 hour.
Drizzle with olive oil before serving.

name: Turkey Kale White Bean Soup
steps: Brown turkey with onion and carrot in oil; add garlic and rosemary.
Add broth and beans; simmer 15 minutes.
Add kale for 5 minutes; serve with parmesan.

name: Cabbage Roll Soup
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Brown beef and onion in oil; add garlic and paprika.
Add tomatoes, sauce, broth and cabbage; simmer 25 minutes.
Add cauliflower rice for 5 minutes; finish with dill.

name: Cod & Vegetable Stew
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic with paprika in oil 6 minutes; add wine.
Add tomatoes, broth, chickpeas, kale; simmer 12 minutes.
Add cod chunks; cook 6 minutes; finish with parsley.

name: Spinach & Egg White Soup
steps: Simmer broth with ginger, garlic and tamari.
Drizzle in egg whites while stirring.
Add spinach, sesame oil and green onion.

name: Chicken Barley Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, mushrooms in oil 6 minutes; add garlic and thyme.
Add broth and chicken; simmer 25 minutes; shred chicken.
Stir in cooked barley; finish with parsley.

name: Golden Turmeric Chicken Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery in oil with turmeric, ginger and garlic.
Add broth and chicken; simmer 20 minutes; shred.
Add cauliflower rice 5 minutes; finish with lemon, parsley, pepper.

name: Italian Sausage & Zucchini Soup
steps: Brown sausage; add onion and garlic.
Add tomatoes, broth and zucchini; simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in spinach; serve with parmesan.

name: Tofu Vegetable Ramen (Shirataki)
steps: Simmer broth with ginger, garlic, tamari and shiitake 8 minutes; add bok choy 2 minutes.
Rinse shirataki well and add to bowls with pan-seared tofu.
Whisk miso into broth off heat; pour over; top with halved eggs, green onion, sesame oil, nori.

name: Turkey Pumpkin Chili
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper in oil; add garlic and spices.
Add pumpkin, tomatoes, beans, broth; simmer 30 minutes.
Season; serve with yogurt and pepitas.

name: Seafood & Fennel Broth
steps: Sauté fennel, leek and garlic in oil 6 minutes; add wine.
Add broth and tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
Add cod and shrimp 5 minutes; finish with parsley and lemon.

name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken Breast
steps: Marinate chicken in lemon, oil, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper 15 minutes.
Grill 6–7 minutes per side until 165°F; rest 5 minutes.
Serve with steamed broccoli and quinoa.

name: Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas
steps: Toss sliced chicken, peppers and onion with oil and spices on a sheet pan.
Roast at 425°F for 20 minutes, stirring once.
Squeeze lime over; serve in warm tortillas with yogurt and cilantro.

name: Chicken Stir-Fry with Broccoli & Cashews
steps: Toss sliced chicken with arrowroot and half the tamari.
Stir-fry chicken in avocado oil until golden; remove. Stir-fry broccoli, pepper, garlic, ginger 4 minutes.
Return chicken with remaining tamari, vinegar and sesame oil; toss with cashews and green onion.

name: Baked Chicken Parmesan (Almond Crust)
steps: Pound chicken thin; dip in egg then almond flour mixed with half the parmesan and seasoning.
Bake on an oiled sheet at 425°F 15 minutes; top with marinara and mozzarella; bake 8 more minutes.
Serve over sautéed zoodles with basil and remaining parmesan.

name: Greek Chicken Skewers with Tzatziki
steps: Marinate chicken cubes in lemon, oil, garlic, oregano and salt 20 minutes; thread onto skewers.
Grill 10–12 minutes, turning.
Mix yogurt with grated squeezed cucumber, dill and garlic for tzatziki; serve with tomatoes and onion.

name: Slow Cooker Salsa Chicken
steps: Place chicken, salsa and spices in a slow cooker; cook on low 4 hours.
Shred chicken in the sauce; stir in beans.
Serve over romaine with avocado, cheddar and yogurt.

name: Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Brown chicken in oil; remove. Sauté onion, pepper, mushrooms 6 minutes; add garlic and herbs.
Deglaze with wine; add tomatoes, olives, capers; return chicken.
Simmer covered 30 minutes; serve with sautéed greens or cauliflower rice.

name: Turkey Meatballs in Marinara over Zoodles
steps: Mix turkey, egg, parmesan, almond flour, garlic, parsley, seasoning and salt; form 16 meatballs.
Brown in oil, add marinara and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over lightly sautéed zoodles.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala (Yogurt Sauce)
steps: Marinate chicken in half the yogurt with half the spices 20 minutes; broil 8 minutes.
Sauté onion, ginger, garlic and remaining spices in oil; add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Add coconut milk, remaining yogurt and chicken; simmer 8 minutes. Serve over cauliflower rice with cilantro.

name: Buffalo Chicken Lettuce Wraps
steps: Toss shredded chicken with hot sauce and melted butter.
Mix yogurt and blue cheese.
Fill lettuce leaves with chicken, celery, carrot and blue cheese sauce.

name: Chicken Piccata
steps: Pound chicken thin, season, dust with almond flour and sear in oil 4 minutes per side; remove.
Add garlic, broth, lemon and capers; simmer 3 minutes; whisk in butter.
Return chicken to coat; serve with steamed green beans and parsley.

name: Chicken & Vegetable Curry
steps: Fry curry paste in oil 1 minute; add chicken and brown 5 minutes.
Add coconut milk, broth and vegetables; simmer 15 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and lime; top with basil; serve with a small portion of brown rice.

name: Herb Roasted Whole Chicken with Vegetables
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Rub chicken with oil, herbs, salt; stuff with lemon and garlic.
Roast on a bed of carrots and onion 60 minutes; add sprouts for the last 25 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes; carve, removing most skin, and serve with the vegetables.

name: Chicken Shawarma Bowls
steps: Marinate chicken in spices, garlic, lemon, oil 15 minutes; roast at 425°F 20 minutes; slice.
Sauté cauliflower rice; whisk tahini with yogurt, lemon and water.
Bowl cauliflower rice, chicken, cucumber, tomato, sauce and parsley.

name: Turkey Burgers with Avocado (Lettuce Bun)
steps: Mix turkey with grated onion, garlic, Dijon, egg and salt; form 4 patties.
Grill or pan-sear in oil 6–7 minutes per side to 165°F.
Serve in lettuce leaves with avocado, tomato and red onion.

name: Chicken Marsala with Mushrooms
steps: Pound chicken, season, sear in oil 4 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté mushrooms and shallot 6 minutes; add garlic, wine, broth, thyme; reduce by half; swirl in butter.
Return chicken 3 minutes; serve with roasted asparagus and parsley.

name: Pesto Chicken Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve and seed peppers; roast cut-side down at 400°F 10 minutes.
Mix chicken, pesto, cauliflower rice, chopped tomato, spinach and half the mozzarella.
Fill peppers, top with remaining cheese; bake 20 minutes.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Bowl (No-Sugar Sauce)
steps: Whisk tamari, vinegar, ginger, garlic, sweetener, sesame oil and arrowroot with 60 ml water.
Sear chicken in avocado oil 8 minutes; add sauce and simmer until glossy.
Serve over brown rice with steamed broccoli and carrot; top with sesame and green onion.

name: Chicken Enchiladas (Low-Carb Tortillas)
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Mix chicken, beans, chiles, onion, half the cheese and a third of the sauce.
Fill and roll tortillas; place seam-side down in a baking dish; pour over remaining sauce and cheese.
Bake at 375°F 20 minutes; serve with yogurt and cilantro.

name: Spatchcock Lemon Pepper Chicken
steps: Remove backbone and flatten chicken; rub with oil, lemon zest, pepper, garlic, thyme and salt.
Roast at 450°F 40–45 minutes to 165°F; add green beans and tomatoes to the pan for the last 15 minutes.
Rest, carve and serve, removing skin.

name: Chicken Lettuce Wraps (PF Chang's Style)
steps: Brown chicken in avocado oil; add garlic, ginger, mushrooms, water chestnuts 4 minutes.
Add tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, sriracha; cook 2 minutes; stir in green onion.
Spoon into lettuce cups.

name: Coconut Lime Chicken Thighs
steps: Sear seasoned chicken in oil 4 minutes per side.
Add coconut milk, lime juice, garlic, ginger, jalapeño; simmer covered 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach; serve over cauliflower rice with cilantro and lime zest.

name: Chicken Cobb Bowl Meal Prep
steps: Grill chicken and slice; boil eggs; crisp bacon.
Divide romaine, tomatoes, chicken, eggs, bacon and blue cheese into 4 containers.
Pack dressing (oil, vinegar, Dijon) and avocado separately; add before eating.

name: Turkey Stuffed Zucchini Boats
steps: Halve zucchini lengthwise, scoop out centers and chop the flesh.
Brown turkey with onion, garlic, zucchini flesh and seasoning; stir in marinara.
Fill boats, top with cheeses; bake at 400°F 20 minutes.

name: Chicken Adobo (Filipino-Style)
steps: Brown chicken in oil; add onion and garlic.
Add tamari, vinegar, bay leaves and pepper with 150 ml water; simmer covered 35 minutes, uncovered the last 10 to reduce.
Serve with sautéed bok choy and cauliflower rice.

name: Almond-Crusted Chicken Tenders
steps: Cut chicken into strips; dip in egg then almond flour-parmesan-spice mix.
Bake on an oiled rack at 425°F 18 minutes, flipping once.
Mix yogurt and Dijon for dipping; serve with roasted broccoli.

name: Chicken & Broccoli Alfredo (Cauliflower Sauce)
steps: Simmer cauliflower with garlic in broth 12 minutes; blend with milk, parmesan, nutmeg and salt into a creamy sauce.
Sear chicken pieces in oil; steam broccoli; cook pasta al dente.
Toss everything with the sauce.

name: Jerk Chicken with Cabbage Slaw
steps: Blend jalapeño, green onion, garlic, ginger, spices, tamari, half the lime, oil into a paste; coat chicken 15 minutes.
Grill or roast at 425°F 22 minutes.
Toss cabbage and carrot with yogurt, remaining lime and salt.

name: Chicken Zucchini Poppers
steps: Grate zucchini and squeeze dry; mix with chicken, green onion, cilantro, garlic, cumin and salt.
Form small balls and bake on an oiled sheet at 400°F 18 minutes.
Serve with guacamole.

name: Chicken Souvlaki Plate
steps: Marinate chicken cubes in lemon, oil, garlic, oregano, salt; skewer and grill 10–12 minutes.
Make tzatziki with yogurt, grated cucumber and dill.
Serve with tomato, onion and warm pita halves.

name: Turkey Taco Skillet
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper in oil; add seasoning.
Add beans, tomatoes and cauliflower rice; simmer 8 minutes.
Top with cheddar, cover to melt; serve with avocado, yogurt and cilantro.

name: Chicken Caprese Skillet
steps: Sear seasoned chicken in oil 5 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté garlic and tomatoes until they burst; add balsamic and spinach.
Return chicken, top with mozzarella; cover 2 minutes; scatter basil.

name: Chicken & Chickpea Tagine
steps: Brown chicken in oil; remove. Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and spices 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, chickpeas, olives, lemon; return chicken; simmer covered 30 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro; serve with cauliflower couscous.

name: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs with Roasted Veggies
steps: Rub chicken with spices, salt and half the oil; air fry at 400°F 18 minutes, flipping once.
Toss vegetables with remaining oil; roast at 425°F 20 minutes.
Serve together.

name: Chicken Pad Thai with Zoodles
steps: Whisk fish sauce, lime, tamari, sweetener.
Stir-fry chicken in oil with garlic; push aside and scramble eggs.
Add zoodles, sauce, sprouts and green onion; toss 2 minutes; top with peanuts, cilantro.

name: Rosemary Garlic Roasted Chicken Legs
steps: Rub chicken with rosemary, garlic, lemon zest, oil and salt.
Roast at 425°F with cauliflower and carrot 40–45 minutes.
