Squeeze lemon over before serving.

name: Chicken Fried Cauliflower Rice
steps: Stir-fry diced chicken in avocado oil; remove.
Scramble eggs; add carrot, garlic, ginger, cauliflower rice; stir-fry 5 minutes.
Add peas, chicken, tamari and sesame oil; finish with green onion.

name: Turkey Sloppy Joes on Lettuce
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper in oil; add garlic.
Add tomato sauce, paste, vinegar, Dijon, paprika and sweetener; simmer 10 minutes.
Serve on toasted English muffin halves or in lettuce cups.

name: Chicken Florentine
steps: Sear chicken in oil 5 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté garlic and sun-dried tomatoes; add broth, cream cheese, milk and parmesan; whisk smooth.
Wilt spinach in the sauce, return chicken; simmer 5 minutes.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowls
steps: Season chicken with chili powder, cumin, lime; grill and slice.
Mix brown rice and cauliflower rice for a half-carb base.
Bowl rice, beans, chicken, pico, romaine, avocado, cheddar and yogurt.

name: Chicken Vindaloo (Mild)
steps: Blend garlic, ginger, vinegar and spices; marinate chicken 15 minutes.
Sauté onion in oil until golden; add chicken and marinade; cook 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and cauliflower; simmer covered 25 minutes; top with cilantro.

name: Chicken Cordon Bleu (Baked, No Breading)
steps: Butterfly chicken, spread Dijon, layer ham and Swiss; roll and secure.
Sprinkle with almond flour-parmesan; bake at 400°F 25–28 minutes.
Serve with roasted asparagus.

name: Turkey Zucchini Meatloaf
steps: Mix turkey, grated squeezed zucchini, onion, eggs, almond flour, garlic, parmesan, seasoning, salt.
Shape into a loaf; spread with tomato paste mixed with Dijon.
Bake at 375°F 50–55 minutes to 165°F; rest 10 minutes.

name: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
steps: Marinate chicken strips in coconut milk, curry powder, turmeric, garlic and half the tamari 20 minutes; skewer.
Grill 4–5 minutes per side.
Whisk peanut butter, remaining tamari, lime, sriracha and warm water; serve with cucumber.

name: Chicken Kale Sausage Skillet with White Beans
steps: Brown sausage slices in oil; add onion and garlic.
Add kale and broth; cook until wilted.
Stir in beans, pepper flakes, lemon; top with parmesan.

name: Chicken Tinga Tostadas (Low-Carb)
steps: Poach chicken and shred. Blend tomatoes, chipotle, sautéed onion and garlic; simmer with chicken 10 minutes.
Bake tortillas at 400°F 8 minutes until crisp.
Top with beans, tinga, lettuce, cotija, avocado and yogurt.

name: Chicken with Creamy Mushroom Sauce
steps: Sear chicken in oil; remove. Sauté mushrooms, shallot, garlic and thyme 6 minutes.
Add broth; reduce; stir in yogurt and Dijon off the heat.
Return chicken; serve with green beans.

name: Greek Turkey Meatballs with Cucumber Salad
steps: Mix turkey, feta, onion, garlic, oregano, mint, egg, almond flour, salt; form 16 meatballs.
Bake at 400°F 18 minutes.
Serve with cucumber-tomato salad and yogurt-dill sauce.

name: Chicken & Asparagus Sheet Pan with Lemon
steps: Toss chicken and vegetables with oil, garlic, seasoning, salt; arrange on a sheet pan with lemon slices.
Roast at 425°F 22 minutes.
Sprinkle with parmesan.

name: Turkey & Spinach Stuffed Portobellos
steps: Brush caps with oil; roast 8 minutes.
Brown turkey with onion, garlic, seasoning; add spinach and marinara.
Fill caps, top with mozzarella; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.

name: Butter Chicken (Lightened)
steps: Marinate chicken in half the yogurt and spices; broil 8 minutes.
Cook onion, ginger, garlic in butter; add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes; blend.
Add coconut milk, remaining yogurt and chicken; simmer 8 minutes; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Chicken Pesto Zucchini Lasagna
steps: Slice zucchini lengthwise; salt and blot dry 15 minutes; grill briefly.
Brown chicken; mix with marinara. Mix ricotta, egg, pesto, spinach.
Layer zucchini, ricotta and chicken sauce; top with mozzarella and parmesan; bake at 375°F 40 minutes.

name: Mustard Glazed Chicken Thighs
steps: Whisk mustards, vinegar, garlic, sweetener, oil and thyme.
Coat chicken and roast at 425°F 25–28 minutes, basting once.
Serve with green beans.

name: Cashew Chicken
steps: Toss chicken with arrowroot; stir-fry in avocado oil; remove.
Stir-fry vegetables, garlic, ginger 4 minutes; add tamari, vinegar, sesame oil.
Return chicken with cashews; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Chicken Quinoa Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Brown chicken with onion, garlic, cumin; stir in quinoa, tomatoes and spinach.
Fill peppers, top with cheddar; bake at 400°F 20 minutes.

name: Chicken Gyros with Low-Carb Pita
steps: Marinate chicken in half the yogurt, garlic, oregano, lemon, oil, salt; roast at 450°F 20 minutes; slice.
Mix remaining yogurt with grated cucumber and dill.
Fill warm tortillas with chicken, tomato, onion and tzatziki.

name: Chicken Fajita Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Boil whole sweet potatoes 20–25 minutes until tender (boiling keeps the GI far lower than baking).
Sauté chicken strips, pepper and onion with seasoning in oil.
Split potatoes, fill with fajita mix; top with cheddar, yogurt, cilantro, lime.

name: Turkey Bolognese over Spaghetti Squash
steps: Halve squash, roast cut-side down at 400°F 40 minutes; scrape strands.
Brown turkey with onion, carrot, celery, garlic; add wine, tomatoes, seasoning; simmer 25 minutes; stir in milk.
Serve sauce over squash with parmesan.

name: Chicken Tenders with Buffalo Cauliflower
steps: Coat chicken strips in egg then almond flour-paprika; bake at 425°F 18 minutes.
Toss cauliflower in oil; roast 20 minutes; toss in hot sauce and butter.
Mix yogurt and blue cheese; serve with celery.

name: One-Pot Chicken, Kale & Farro
steps: Sear chicken in oil; remove. Sauté onion and garlic; add cooked farro, broth, thyme.
Return chicken, simmer covered 15 minutes.
Stir in kale until wilted; finish with lemon and parmesan.

name: Chicken Lemon Garlic Zoodle Bowl
steps: Sear chicken pieces in oil with garlic; remove.
Sauté tomatoes 2 minutes; add zoodles, lemon zest and juice; toss 2 minutes.
Return chicken; top with parmesan, basil, pepper flakes.

name: Chicken Cauliflower Fried Rice with Kimchi
steps: Stir-fry chicken in avocado oil until browned.
Add garlic, kimchi, cauliflower rice; cook 5 minutes; push aside and scramble eggs.
Stir in tamari, gochujang, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Crispy Baked Chicken Thighs with Roasted Cabbage
steps: Rub chicken with paprika, garlic powder, salt and half the oil.
Cut cabbage into wedges, brush with oil, Dijon and vinegar.
Roast everything at 425°F 35–40 minutes.

name: Chicken Tostada Salad Bowl with Refried Beans
steps: Season chicken; sear and slice.
Bake tortillas until crisp.
Layer beans, romaine, chicken, pico, cotija, avocado and yogurt over the tortillas.

name: Mediterranean Chicken Thighs with Olives & Artichokes
steps: Sear chicken in oil; add garlic, artichokes, olives, tomatoes, lemon slices, oregano.
Roast at 400°F 25 minutes.
Top with feta and parsley.

name: Peruvian-Style Roast Chicken with Green Sauce
steps: Rub chicken with cumin, paprika, garlic, lime, oil and salt; roast at 425°F 30 minutes.
Blend yogurt, cilantro, jalapeño, mayo and lime into green sauce.
Serve chicken with sauce and romaine.

name: Chicken & Black Bean Quesadillas
steps: Mix chicken, beans, pepper and cumin.
Fill half of each tortilla with cheese and filling; fold.
Cook in oil 3 minutes per side; serve with salsa and yogurt.

name: Chicken & Spinach Stuffed Chicken Breast
steps: Cut pockets in chicken; fill with wilted spinach, cream cheese, mozzarella, garlic, sun-dried tomato.
Season, sear in oil 3 minutes per side; bake at 400°F 18 minutes.
Serve with roasted broccoli.

name: Chicken Yakitori Skewers
steps: Simmer tamari, vinegar, ginger, garlic, sweetener into a glaze.
Skewer chicken and green onion pieces; grill 10–12 minutes, brushing with glaze.
Serve with sautéed bok choy and sesame seeds.

name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Cauliflower Casserole
steps: Steam cauliflower 5 minutes; cook and dice chicken; crisp bacon.
Mix yogurt, cream cheese and ranch; fold in chicken and cauliflower.
Top with cheddar and bacon; bake at 375°F 20 minutes; add green onion.

name: Sesame Ginger Chicken Lettuce Cups
steps: Brown chicken in avocado oil with ginger and garlic.
Add tamari, vinegar, sesame oil and grated carrot; cook 2 minutes.
Serve in lettuce cups with cucumber, green onion and sesame.

name: Chicken Provençal
steps: Sear chicken in oil; remove. Sauté shallot and garlic; add wine.
Add tomatoes, olives, herbs, zucchini; return chicken.
Simmer covered 25 minutes.

name: BBQ Chicken Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Boil whole sweet potatoes 20–25 minutes until tender (boiling keeps the GI far lower than baking).
Simmer tomato paste, vinegar, paprika, sweetener, Dijon and 60 ml water into BBQ sauce; toss with chicken.
Split potatoes, fill with chicken; top with slaw mixed with yogurt and green onion.

name: Chicken Tandoori with Cucumber Raita
steps: Marinate chicken in 150 g yogurt, spices, ginger, garlic, lemon, salt for 30 minutes.
Roast at 450°F 22 minutes.
Mix remaining yogurt with grated cucumber, mint for raita.

name: Crispy Chicken Thighs with Brussels & Bacon
steps: Season chicken; sear skin-side down in an ovenproof skillet 6 minutes.
Add halved sprouts, chopped bacon, garlic; roast at 425°F 25 minutes.
Toss sprouts with vinegar and Dijon.

name: Chicken Paprikash (Yogurt)
steps: Brown chicken in oil; remove. Sauté onion and pepper; add paprika, garlic, tomato paste.
Add broth and chicken; simmer covered 25 minutes.
Stir in yogurt off heat; serve over cauliflower rice with parsley.

name: Chicken Zucchini Noodle Pad See Ew
steps: Stir-fry chicken and garlic in oil; push aside and scramble eggs.
Add broccolini 2 minutes; add zoodles, tamari, fish sauce, sweetener.
Toss 2 minutes; finish with pepper.

name: Turkey Cutlets with Sage & Lemon
steps: Pound turkey cutlets thin; season; sear in oil 3 minutes per side.
Add butter, sage, garlic, broth, lemon juice; simmer 2 minutes.
Serve over sautéed spinach.

name: Chicken Cauliflower Curry Bowl
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and curry powder in oil.
Add chicken, cauliflower, chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in spinach; garnish cilantro.

name: Turkey Sausage & Peppers Skillet
steps: Brown sausage in oil; remove.
Sauté peppers, onion, garlic 8 minutes; add tomatoes and seasoning.
Return sausage; simmer 5 minutes; top with parmesan and basil.

name: Chicken Cacciatore Stuffed Spaghetti Squash
steps: Roast halved squash at 400°F 40 minutes; scrape strands.
Brown chicken with pepper, mushrooms, onion, garlic and oregano; add marinara.
Toss with squash strands, return to shells, top with mozzarella; broil 3 minutes.

name: Chicken Larb Bowls with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown chicken in oil; toss off heat with shallot, lime, fish sauce, herbs and pepper flakes.
Sauté cauliflower rice 4 minutes.
Serve larb over cauliflower rice with cucumber.

name: Chicken Kiev-Style Baked Breasts
steps: Mix butter with garlic, parsley, dill; chill. Cut pockets in chicken and stuff with herb butter.
Dip in egg, coat with almond flour; bake at 400°F 25 minutes.
Serve with green beans and lemon.

name: Turkey Kofta with Tahini Sauce
steps: Mix turkey, grated onion, parsley, garlic, spices, egg and salt; form logs on skewers.
Grill or broil 12 minutes, turning.
Whisk tahini, lemon, yogurt and water; serve with cucumber and tomato.

name: Chicken Zucchini Enchilada Skillet
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Sauté chicken pieces with onion and cumin in oil.
Add zucchini, beans and sauce; simmer 8 minutes.
Top with cheddar; cover to melt; serve with cilantro and yogurt.

name: Chicken Cauliflower Mac & Cheese Bake
steps: Steam cauliflower; cook pasta al dente; sear diced chicken in oil.
Warm milk, cream cheese, cheddar, Dijon, garlic powder into a sauce.
Combine everything in a dish; bake at 375°F 15 minutes.

name: Duck Breast with Cherry-Balsamic & Greens
steps: Score and season duck; sear skin-side down 8 minutes, flip 4 minutes; rest and slice, discarding excess skin.
Sauté shallot in drippings; add cherries, balsamic, broth, thyme; reduce.
Serve duck over arugula with sauce.

name: Chicken Broccoli Cheddar Stuffed Sweet Potato
steps: Boil whole sweet potatoes 20–25 minutes until tender (boiling keeps the GI far lower than baking); steam broccoli.
Mix chicken, broccoli, half the cheddar, yogurt and garlic powder.
Split potatoes, fill, top with remaining cheddar; broil 3 minutes; add green onion.

name: Chicken Vesuvio (Lightened)
steps: Brown chicken and halved potatoes in oil; add garlic and oregano.
Add wine and broth; roast at 400°F 25 minutes.
Add peas for the last 5 minutes; finish with lemon and parsley.

name: Nashville-Style Hot Chicken (Baked)
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the hot sauce 15 minutes; coat in almond flour with cayenne, paprika, garlic powder.
Bake at 425°F 22 minutes; brush with remaining hot sauce mixed with oil.
Serve with vinegar slaw and pickles.

name: Chicken & Mushroom Stroganoff (Yogurt)
steps: Sear chicken strips in oil; remove. Sauté mushrooms, onion, garlic 8 minutes.
Add broth, paprika, Dijon; reduce; stir in yogurt off heat; return chicken.
Serve over sautéed zoodles with parsley.

name: Chicken Poblano Casserole
steps: Char poblanos; peel and chop. Sear diced chicken with onion and cumin in oil.
Mix chicken, poblano, cauliflower rice, beans, salsa verde, yogurt and half the cheese in a dish.
Top with remaining cheese; bake at 375°F 25 minutes; garnish cilantro.

name: Chicken Thighs with Roasted Fennel & Olives
steps: Toss fennel wedges, olives, garlic with oil; nestle chicken on top with lemon slices and rosemary.
Roast at 425°F 30–35 minutes.
Spoon pan juices over.

name: Chicken & Roasted Cauliflower Pesto Skillet
steps: Roast cauliflower florets with oil at 425°F 20 minutes.
Sear chicken pieces; add tomatoes and spinach.
Toss chicken, cauliflower and pesto; top with parmesan.

name: Chicken & Veggie Kabobs with Chimichurri
steps: Thread chicken and vegetables onto skewers; brush with a third of the oil; season.
Grill 10–12 minutes, turning.
Blend remaining oil, herbs, garlic, vinegar, oregano, pepper flakes; spoon over.

name: Turkey Meatball Zucchini Skillet with Feta
steps: Mix turkey, egg, almond flour, oregano, garlic, salt; form meatballs; brown in oil.
Add zucchini and tomatoes; cover and cook 10 minutes.
Top with feta and lemon.

name: Chicken Chow Mein (Shirataki)
steps: Rinse and dry-fry shirataki 3 minutes; set aside.
Stir-fry chicken in oil; add garlic, ginger, cabbage, carrot, celery 4 minutes.
Add noodles, sprouts, tamari, sesame oil; toss; top green onion.

name: Chicken Spinach Artichoke Casserole
steps: Cook and dice chicken; wilt spinach with garlic.
Mix cream cheese, yogurt, parmesan; fold in chicken, spinach, artichokes.
Top with mozzarella; bake at 375°F 20 minutes.

name: Whole Roasted Turkey Breast with Herb Rub
steps: Rub turkey with oil, garlic, herbs, lemon zest and salt.
Roast at 350°F with broth in the pan 80–90 minutes to 165°F, basting.
Rest 15 minutes; slice; serve with green beans.

name: Chicken Pesto Stuffed Zucchini
steps: Halve zucchini and scoop centers.
Mix chicken, pesto, ricotta and chopped tomato; fill boats.
Top with cheeses; bake at 400°F 25 minutes.

name: Coq au Vin (Lightened)
steps: Brown chicken and bacon in oil; remove. Sauté onion, carrot, mushrooms, garlic; add tomato paste.
Add wine, broth, thyme, bay; return chicken; simmer covered 45 minutes.
Uncover last 10 minutes to reduce; serve with cauliflower mash.

name: Sesame Chicken (No-Sugar Glaze)
steps: Sear chicken pieces in avocado oil until golden.
Add tamari, vinegar, garlic, ginger, sweetener and arrowroot slurry; simmer until glossy; add sesame oil.
Top with sesame seeds and green onion; serve with steamed broccoli.

name: Crustless Chicken Pot Pie Skillet
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, mushrooms in oil; add diced chicken and thyme.
Blend steamed cauliflower with milk; add to skillet with broth; simmer 12 minutes.
Add peas; top with almond flour-parmesan crumble and broil 3 minutes.

name: Chicken Bruschetta Bake
steps: Season chicken, sear 3 minutes per side, transfer to a dish.
Top with diced tomato, basil, garlic, balsamic and mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F 15 minutes; serve on zoodles.

name: Chili Lime Chicken Wings (Baked)
steps: Toss wings with oil, lime zest, garlic, chili powder, cumin, salt.
Bake on a rack at 425°F 40–45 minutes until crisp.
Squeeze lime, add cilantro; serve with celery and yogurt dip.

name: Chicken Kale Caesar Wrap
steps: Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, mashed anchovy.
Toss chopped kale, chicken and parmesan with dressing.
Roll in tortillas.

name: Turkey Chili Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Brown turkey with onion and spices; add beans and tomatoes; simmer 8 minutes.
Fill peppers, top with cheddar; bake at 400°F 18 minutes; add green onion.

name: Lemon Dill Chicken Salad Cucumber Boats
steps: Mix chicken, yogurt, dill, lemon, celery, onion, salt.
Halve cucumbers lengthwise and scoop seeds.
Fill with chicken salad.

name: Chicken Mole (Simplified)
steps: Sauté onion and garlic; blend with chipotle, tomatoes, cocoa, almond butter, spices, broth.
Brown chicken in oil; pour sauce over; simmer covered 30 minutes.
Top with sesame seeds; serve with cauliflower rice.

name: Chicken Alfredo Spaghetti Squash Boats
steps: Roast halved squash 40 minutes.
Simmer cauliflower and garlic in milk; blend with parmesan and cream cheese.
Toss squash strands with sauce, cooked chicken and spinach; top with mozzarella; broil 3 minutes.

name: Chicken Tortilla-Crusted Casserole (Low-Carb)
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Cook and shred chicken; sauté onion.
Layer torn tortillas, chicken, beans, corn, chiles, sauce and cheese in a dish.
Bake at 375°F 25 minutes; serve with yogurt.

name: Za'atar Chicken with Cucumber Yogurt
steps: Rub chicken with za'atar, lemon, oil, garlic, salt; roast with cauliflower at 425°F 25 minutes.
Mix yogurt with cucumber and mint.
Serve chicken with yogurt sauce.

name: Chicken Marbella (No Prunes)
steps: Marinate chicken with olives, capers, garlic, oregano, vinegar, oil, bay 20 minutes.
Roast at 400°F with wine poured around 35 minutes.
Top with parsley; serve with green beans.

name: Turkey Meatballs with Zucchini & Tzatziki Pita
steps: Mix turkey with grated squeezed zucchini, garlic, oregano, egg, almond flour, salt; form meatballs; bake at 400°F 18 minutes.
Mix yogurt, grated cucumber, dill.
Serve in pita halves with tomato and tzatziki.

name: Classic Beef Chili (Bean-Heavy)
steps: Brown beef with onion and pepper in oil; drain fat; add garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes, beans, broth; simmer 45 minutes.
Serve with yogurt, cheddar and jalapeño.

name: Steak with Chimichurri & Roasted Broccoli
steps: Roast broccoli with a third of the oil at 425°F 18 minutes.
Season steak; grill 4–5 minutes per side; rest 5 minutes and slice against the grain.
Blend remaining oil, herbs, garlic, vinegar, oregano, pepper flakes; spoon over steak.

name: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Toss sliced beef with arrowroot and half the tamari; sear in avocado oil; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli, garlic, ginger 4 minutes; add broth, remaining tamari, vinegar; cover 2 minutes.
Return beef with sesame oil; serve over cauliflower rice with green onion.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Apple & Sage
steps: Season pork; sear in oil; roast at 425°F 15 minutes; rest.
Sauté onion and apple slices with sage; add Dijon, vinegar, broth; reduce.
Slice pork; serve with apple-sage pan sauce and roasted sprouts.

name: Beef Lettuce Wrap Tacos
steps: Brown beef with taco seasoning; drain.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.
Top with pico, avocado, cheddar, yogurt, jalapeño and lime.

name: Pork Chops with Sautéed Cabbage & Mustard
steps: Season chops; sear in oil 4 minutes per side; rest.
Sauté onion and cabbage in the pan 8 minutes; add vinegar, broth and Dijon.
Serve chops over the cabbage.

name: Beef & Vegetable Kabobs
steps: Marinate beef cubes in oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, cumin 20 minutes.
Thread with vegetables; grill 10–12 minutes.
Serve with yogurt-mint sauce.

name: Meatloaf with Hidden Vegetables
steps: Pulse mushrooms, carrot, onion finely; sauté 5 minutes; cool.
Mix with beef, eggs, oats, garlic, Dijon, thyme, salt; shape a loaf.
Glaze with tomato paste and vinegar; bake at 375°F 55–60 minutes.

name: Bison Burgers with Portobello Buns
steps: Brush portobellos with oil; grill 4 minutes per side.
Form bison patties; grill 5 minutes per side; top with cheddar.
Assemble burgers between mushroom caps with tomato, onion, arugula, Dijon.

name: Pork Stir-Fry with Snap Peas & Ginger
steps: Toss pork strips with arrowroot and half the tamari; stir-fry in oil; remove.
Stir-fry snap peas, pepper, ginger, garlic 3 minutes.
Return pork with remaining tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Slow Cooker Pot Roast with Root Vegetables
steps: Sear seasoned roast in oil on all sides.
Place in slow cooker with vegetables, garlic, broth, tomato paste, herbs.
Cook on low 8 hours; shred and serve with the vegetables and juices.

name: Lamb Chops with Mint Yogurt & Roasted Cauliflower
steps: Roast cauliflower with half the oil and cumin at 425°F 22 minutes.
Season chops with garlic, lemon zest, salt; sear 3–4 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt, mint, lemon juice; serve alongside.

name: Beef Stuffed Cabbage Rolls (Cauliflower Rice)
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Blanch cabbage leaves 3 minutes. Mix beef, cauliflower rice, sautéed onion, egg, garlic, paprika, salt.
Roll filling in leaves; place seam-down in a dish; pour over tomato sauce and tomatoes.
Cover and bake at 350°F 70 minutes; garnish dill.

name: Pork Carnitas Bowls
steps: Slow-cook pork with orange, lime, garlic, cumin, oregano, onion, broth, salt on low 4 hours.
Shred; crisp under the broiler 5 minutes.
Bowl with cauliflower rice, beans, pico, avocado, cilantro.

name: Beef Bulgogi Lettuce Wraps
steps: Marinate thinly sliced beef in tamari, grated pear, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, sweetener 20 minutes.
Sear in a hot pan with avocado oil 2 minutes per batch.
Serve in lettuce with kimchi, green onion, sesame.

name: Italian Sausage & Pepper Zoodles
steps: Brown pork with fennel seeds, seasoning and pepper flakes (homemade sausage).
Add peppers, onion, garlic; cook 6 minutes; add marinara.
Serve over sautéed zoodles with parmesan.

name: Beef Taco Stuffed Zucchini
steps: Halve zucchini; scoop centers and chop.
Brown beef with onion, zucchini flesh, seasoning; add beans and salsa.
Fill boats, top with cheddar; bake at 400°F 20 minutes; serve with yogurt and cilantro.

name: Pork Chops with Roasted Brussels & Balsamic
steps: Roast halved sprouts with half the oil at 425°F 20 minutes.
Season chops with rosemary and garlic; sear 4–5 minutes per side.
Toss sprouts with balsamic and Dijon; serve with chops.

name: Shepherd's Pie with Cauliflower Mash
steps: Brown lamb with onion, carrot, mushrooms, garlic; add tomato paste, broth, thyme, peas; simmer 10 minutes.
Steam cauliflower; mash with butter, milk, parmesan, salt.
Spread mash over filling; bake at 400°F 25 minutes.

name: Beef & Mushroom Stroganoff (Yogurt)
ing: Whole wheat pasta, cooked al dente
steps: Sear beef strips in oil; remove. Sauté mushrooms, onion, garlic 8 minutes; add paprika, broth, Dijon.
Stir in yogurt off the heat; return beef.
Serve over al dente whole wheat pasta with parsley.

name: Pork Tenderloin Medallions with Mushroom Sauce
steps: Slice pork into medallions; season; sear 3 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté mushrooms, shallot, garlic, thyme; add wine and broth; reduce; stir in yogurt off heat.
Return pork; serve with green beans.

name: Beef Fajita Bowls
steps: Season steak with chili powder, cumin, lime; grill and slice.
Sauté peppers and onion in oil until charred.
Bowl cauliflower rice, beans, steak, peppers, avocado, salsa, yogurt, cilantro.

name: Lamb Kofta with Cucumber Salad
steps: Mix lamb, grated onion, herbs, garlic, spices, salt; shape onto skewers.
Grill 12 minutes, turning.
Serve with cucumber-tomato salad and lemon yogurt.

name: Cuban Ropa Vieja
steps: Sear steak in oil; remove. Sauté peppers, onion, garlic; add cumin, oregano, wine.
Add tomatoes, broth, bay, steak; simmer covered 2.5 hours until shreddable.
Shred, return to sauce with olives; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Pork & Green Bean Stir-Fry with Garlic
steps: Blister green beans in avocado oil over high heat 5 minutes; remove.
Brown pork with garlic and ginger; add tamari, vinegar, chili crisp.
Return beans; toss with sesame oil and green onion.

name: Beef Kebab Bowls with Tabbouleh
steps: Mix beef with grated onion, a third of the parsley, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt; form kebabs; grill 10 minutes.
Toss bulgur with remaining parsley, tomato, cucumber, mint, lemon, oil.
Serve kebabs over tabbouleh with yogurt.

name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites with Zucchini
steps: Sear beef cubes in oil over high heat 2 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté zucchini 4 minutes; add butter and garlic 1 minute.
Return beef; toss with parsley and pepper flakes.

name: Pork Souvlaki with Greek Salad
steps: Marinate pork cubes in lemon, oil, garlic, oregano, salt 20 minutes; skewer; grill 10–12 minutes.
Toss tomato, cucumber, onion, olives, feta.
Serve with yogurt-dill sauce.

name: Beef Ragu over Spaghetti Squash
steps: Brown beef cubes in oil; sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic; add wine, tomatoes, broth, rosemary.
Simmer covered 80 minutes; shred beef into sauce.
Roast squash; serve ragu over strands with parmesan.

name: Pork Egg Roll in a Bowl
steps: Brown pork in oil with garlic and ginger.
Add slaw, tamari, vinegar; cook 5 minutes until wilted; push aside, scramble eggs.
Finish with sesame oil, green onion, sriracha.

name: Beef & Bean Enchilada Casserole (Low-Carb)
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Brown beef with onion and cumin; stir in beans and chiles.
Layer tortillas, beef, sauce and cheese in a dish.
Bake at 375°F 25 minutes; serve with yogurt and cilantro.

name: Pork Loin with Mustard Herb Crust & Green Beans
steps: Rub pork with Dijon, garlic, herbs, salt; press on almond flour.
Roast at 400°F 20 minutes (tenderloin) to 145°F; rest.
Serve with green beans tossed in oil.

name: Beef Barbacoa Lettuce Tacos
steps: Blend chipotle, garlic, cumin, oregano, lime, vinegar, broth; pour over beef in slow cooker with bay leaves.
Cook on low 5 hours; shred.
Serve in lettuce with onion, cilantro, cotija.

name: Pork Chops with Peach Salsa
steps: Rub chops with paprika and salt; grill 4–5 minutes per side.
Dice peach, onion, jalapeño; toss with cilantro and lime.
Serve chops with salsa over arugula.

name: Beef Zucchini Lasagna
steps: Slice zucchini into planks; salt, drain 15 minutes, blot; grill briefly.
Brown beef with garlic and seasoning; add marinara. Mix ricotta, egg, spinach.
Layer; top with mozzarella and parmesan; bake at 375°F 40 minutes; rest 10.

name: Vietnamese Pork Meatball Bowls
steps: Mix pork, garlic, half the fish sauce, green onion, ginger; form meatballs; pan-fry in oil 10 minutes.
Toss cabbage, carrot, cucumber, herbs with lime, vinegar and remaining fish sauce.
Serve over cauliflower rice with peanuts.

name: Steak Fajita Lettuce Wraps
steps: Season steak; sear 4 minutes per side; rest, slice.
Sauté peppers and onion in oil until charred.
Fill romaine leaves with steak, peppers, guacamole, salsa.

name: Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry with Bok Choy
steps: Stir-fry pork strips in oil; remove.
Stir-fry shiitake, garlic, ginger; add bok choy 3 minutes.
Return pork with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; top sesame.

name: Beef Picadillo
steps: Brown beef with onion, pepper, garlic; add spices.
Add tomatoes, paste, olives, capers; simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Rosemary Lamb Leg with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Rub lamb with garlic, rosemary, lemon zest, oil, Dijon, salt; rest 30 minutes.
Roast at 375°F 75–90 minutes to 135°F for medium-rare, adding vegetables around it after 30 minutes.
Rest 15 minutes; slice thin.

name: Cheeseburger Salad
steps: Brown beef; season; drain.
Whisk yogurt, mayo, mustard and pickle juice into 'special sauce'.
Toss romaine, tomato, pickle, onion; top with beef, cheddar, sauce.

name: Pork & Cabbage Dumpling-Filling Skillet
steps: Brown pork with ginger and garlic in oil.
Add cabbage, tamari, vinegar; cook 5 minutes.
Finish with sesame oil, green onion, chili crisp.

name: Beef Stuffed Peppers with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Brown beef with onion, garlic, seasoning; add cauliflower rice and tomatoes.
Fill peppers, top with mozzarella; bake at 400°F 20 minutes.

name: Pork Chile Verde
steps: Broil tomatillos, poblano, jalapeño, onion, garlic 10 minutes; blend with cilantro.
Brown pork cubes in oil; add sauce, cumin, broth; simmer covered 1.5–2 hours.
Finish with lime; serve with cauliflower rice.

name: Steak & Eggs Power Bowl with Kale
steps: Roast diced sweet potato with half the oil at 425°F 18 minutes.
Sear steak 4 minutes per side; rest, slice. Sauté kale with garlic; fry eggs.
Bowl everything with avocado and hot sauce.

name: Greek Beef Meatballs with Zucchini Salad
steps: Mix beef, feta, onion, garlic, oregano, mint, egg, almond flour, salt; form meatballs; bake at 400°F 18 minutes.
Shave zucchini; toss with tomato, lemon, oil.
Serve with yogurt.

name: Bacon-Wrapped Pork Tenderloin with Asparagus
steps: Rub pork with Dijon, garlic, thyme; wrap in bacon.
Roast at 425°F 25 minutes to 145°F; broil 2 minutes to crisp.
Roast asparagus with oil alongside; slice pork.

name: Beef Shawarma Plate
steps: Marinate sliced steak in spices, garlic, lemon, oil 15 minutes; sear in a hot pan 5 minutes.
Whisk tahini with lemon and water.
Plate beef with hummus, tomato, cucumber, onion, parsley, tahini sauce.

name: Pork Ribs (Baked, Sugar-Free Rub)
steps: Rub ribs with spices, sweetener, salt; wrap in foil; bake at 300°F 2 hours.
Mix tomato paste, vinegar, Dijon into a glaze; brush on and broil 5 minutes.
Serve with yogurt slaw.

name: Beef Kofta Bowls with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Mix beef, onion, parsley, garlic, spices, salt; shape kofta; grill 12 minutes.
Sauté cauliflower rice.
Bowl with tomato, cucumber, yogurt-tahini-lemon sauce.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Chimichurri & Cauliflower
steps: Roast cauliflower with a third of the oil at 425°F 22 minutes.
Sear seasoned pork; roast 15 minutes; rest, slice.
Blend remaining oil, herbs, garlic, vinegar, oregano, pepper flakes; spoon over.

name: Beef & Cauliflower Shepherd's Skillet
steps: Brown beef with onion, carrot, garlic; add tomato paste, broth, thyme, peas; simmer 8 minutes.
Steam and mash cauliflower; spread over the skillet.
Top with cheddar; broil 4 minutes.

name: Pork Chops with Kale & White Beans
steps: Season chops; sear 4–5 minutes per side; rest.
Sauté garlic and kale in the pan; add beans and broth; simmer 5 minutes.
Finish with lemon and pepper flakes; serve with chops.

name: Beef Satay with Cucumber Salad
steps: Marinate steak strips in tamari, garlic, ginger, curry powder, coconut milk 20 minutes; skewer; grill 3 minutes per side.
Whisk peanut butter, lime, sriracha, warm water.
Toss cucumber and onion with rice vinegar; serve with satay and sauce.

name: Italian Beef Stuffed Mushrooms (Large)
steps: Brush caps with oil; roast 8 minutes.
Brown beef with onion, garlic, seasoning; add spinach and marinara.
Fill caps; top with cheeses; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.

name: Pork Lettuce Cups with Peanut Sauce
steps: Brown pork with garlic, ginger, half the tamari.
Whisk peanut butter, remaining tamari, lime, sriracha, water.
Fill lettuce with pork, carrot, cucumber, cilantro; drizzle sauce; top with peanuts.

name: Beef Cabbage Stir-Fry
steps: Brown beef in oil with garlic and ginger.
Add cabbage and carrot; stir-fry 5 minutes.
Add tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Lamb & Eggplant Moussaka (Lightened)
steps: Slice eggplant; brush with oil; roast at 425°F 20 minutes.
Brown lamb with onion, garlic; add tomatoes, cinnamon, oregano; simmer 15 minutes.
Layer eggplant and lamb; top with yogurt whisked with eggs, parmesan, nutmeg; bake at 375°F 35 minutes.

name: Cajun Pork Chops with Collard Greens
steps: Sauté bacon, onion, garlic; add collards, broth, vinegar; simmer covered 20 minutes.
Rub chops with Cajun seasoning; sear 4–5 minutes per side.
Serve chops over greens.

name: Beef & Vegetable Skillet with Sweet Potato
steps: Sauté diced sweet potato in oil covered 8 minutes.
Add beef, pepper, onion, garlic, spices; cook 8 minutes.
Stir in kale; top with avocado.

name: Pork Chops with Creamy Dijon Sauce
steps: Sear seasoned chops; remove.
Sauté shallot and garlic; add broth, Dijon, thyme; reduce; stir in yogurt off heat.
Return chops to coat; serve with steamed broccoli.

name: Ground Beef Zucchini Skillet with Feta
steps: Brown beef with onion and garlic.
Add zucchini, tomatoes, oregano; simmer 10 minutes.
Top with feta and parsley.

name: Pork Tenderloin Banh Mi Bowls
steps: Marinate pork slices in tamari, garlic, fish sauce; sear in oil.
Quick-pickle shredded carrot and daikon in rice vinegar 15 minutes.
Bowl cauliflower rice, pork, pickles, cucumber, jalapeño, cilantro, sriracha mayo.

name: Beef & Black Bean Chili Verde
steps: Brown beef with onion, garlic, cumin.
Add salsa verde, chiles, beans, broth; simmer 30 minutes.
Serve with cilantro and yogurt.

name: Pork Schnitzel (Almond Crust) with Cucumber Salad
steps: Dip cutlets in egg then almond flour-parmesan-paprika.
Pan-fry in oil 3–4 minutes per side.
Toss cucumber with yogurt, dill, vinegar; serve with lemon.

name: Beef Sirloin with Roasted Vegetable Medley
steps: Roast vegetables with half the oil, garlic, rosemary at 425°F 20 minutes.
Sear steak 4 minutes per side; rest, slice.
Drizzle vegetables with balsamic; serve.

name: Lamb Curry with Spinach
steps: Brown lamb cubes; remove. Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, spices.
Add tomatoes, yogurt, lamb; simmer covered 60 minutes.
Stir in spinach; garnish cilantro; serve with cauliflower rice.

name: Pork & Pepper Fajita Skillet
steps: Sauté pork strips with spices in oil; remove.
Sauté peppers and onion until charred; return pork; add lime.
Serve in tortillas with avocado and yogurt.

name: Beef Stew with Mushrooms & Red Wine (Slow Cooker)
steps: Sear beef cubes in oil.
Add to slow cooker with all ingredients.
Cook on low 7 hours; serve over cauliflower mash.

name: Pork Meatballs in Tomato Sauce with Spaghetti Squash
steps: Roast halved squash 40 minutes.
Mix pork, egg, parmesan, almond flour, garlic, parsley, salt; form meatballs; brown in oil; simmer in marinara 15 minutes.
Serve over squash strands.

name: Steak Salad Bowl with Blue Cheese & Walnuts
steps: Sear steak 4 minutes per side; rest, slice.
Toss greens, tomato, onion with oil and balsamic.
Top with steak, blue cheese, walnuts.

name: Pork Ramen Bowl (Shirataki)
steps: Simmer broth with garlic, ginger, tamari, mushrooms 10 minutes; add bok choy.
Sear sliced pork 2 minutes per side.
Whisk miso into broth; assemble with rinsed shirataki, pork, halved eggs, green onion, sesame oil, nori.

name: Beef Empanada-Style Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Brown beef with onion, garlic, spices; add tomatoes, olives, chopped egg.
Fill peppers; top with cotija; bake at 400°F 20 minutes.

name: Pork Green Bean Almond Stir-Fry
steps: Stir-fry pork strips in oil; remove.
Stir-fry green beans with garlic, ginger 5 minutes.
Return pork with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; toss with toasted almonds.

name: Beef Gyro Bowls
steps: Mix beef with grated onion, garlic, oregano, cumin, salt; press into a thin sheet and bake at 425°F 15 minutes; slice into strips.
Sauté cauliflower rice.
Bowl with tomato, cucumber, onion, feta, yogurt-dill sauce.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Fennel & Orange
steps: Toss fennel and onion with half the oil; roast at 425°F 15 minutes.
Add seasoned pork and orange slices; roast 15 minutes more.
Rest and slice; spoon pan juices over.

name: Beef & Broccoli Cauliflower Fried Rice
steps: Brown beef with garlic and ginger; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli and cauliflower rice 5 minutes; scramble eggs in.
Return beef with tamari, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Lamb Burgers with Feta & Tzatziki (Lettuce Bun)
steps: Mix lamb, garlic, oregano, mint, salt; form patties; grill 5 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt, grated cucumber, dill.
Serve in lettuce with feta, tomato, onion, tzatziki.

name: Pork & Brussels Sprout Sheet Pan
steps: Toss sprouts and onion with oil; spread on a pan.
Rub pork with Dijon, garlic, thyme; add to pan.
Roast at 425°F 22 minutes; drizzle vinegar over sprouts.

name: Baked Lemon Garlic Salmon
steps: Place salmon and asparagus on a sheet pan; rub with oil, garlic, salt, pepper; top with lemon slices.
Bake at 400°F 12–15 minutes.
Finish with dill and lemon juice.

name: Shrimp Scampi Zoodles
steps: Sauté garlic in oil and butter 30 seconds; add shrimp, cook 2 minutes per side; remove.
Add wine and lemon juice; reduce 1 minute; add zoodles and toss 2 minutes.
Return shrimp; top with parsley, parmesan, pepper flakes.

name: Blackened Cod with Mango Salsa
steps: Rub cod with spices and salt; sear in oil 3–4 minutes per side.
Dice mango, onion, jalapeño; toss with cilantro and lime.
Serve fish over cauliflower rice with salsa.

name: Tuna Poke Bowl with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Cube tuna; toss with tamari, sesame oil, vinegar, green onion.
Steam cauliflower rice 4 minutes; cool.
Bowl with avocado, cucumber, edamame, seaweed, tuna; top sesame.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp with Asparagus
steps: Sauté asparagus in oil 4 minutes; remove.
Melt butter with garlic; add shrimp, cook 3 minutes.
Return asparagus; finish with lemon, parsley, pepper flakes.

name: Salmon Burgers with Avocado Slaw
steps: Pulse salmon; mix with egg, almond flour, Dijon, green onion, dill, salt; form 4 patties.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes per side.
Mash avocado with yogurt and lime; toss with slaw; serve with burgers.

name: Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
steps: Season fish with chili powder, cumin, salt; sear in oil 3–4 minutes per side; flake.
Toss cabbage with yogurt, mayo, lime, cilantro, jalapeño.
Fill warm tortillas with fish, slaw, avocado.

name: Miso Glazed Salmon with Bok Choy
steps: Whisk miso, tamari, vinegar, ginger, sesame oil; brush on salmon.
Broil 8–10 minutes.
Sauté bok choy with garlic in avocado oil; top salmon with sesame.

name: Shrimp & Cauliflower Grits
steps: Steam cauliflower; blend with milk, cheddar, butter, salt into 'grits'.
Crisp bacon; sauté shrimp with garlic and Cajun seasoning in oil 3 minutes; add lemon.
Serve shrimp over grits with bacon and green onion.

name: Pesto Baked Cod with Cherry Tomatoes
steps: Spread pesto over cod; surround with tomatoes and zucchini tossed in oil.
Bake at 400°F 14 minutes.
Squeeze lemon over.

name: Coconut Curry Shrimp
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, curry paste in oil 2 minutes.
Add coconut milk, pepper, snap peas; simmer 5 minutes.
Add shrimp 3 minutes; finish with fish sauce, lime, basil; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Tuna Salad Stuffed Avocados
steps: Mix tuna, yogurt, Dijon, celery, onion, lemon, pepper.
Halve avocados.
Fill with tuna salad; top chives.

name: Seared Scallops with Cauliflower Purée
steps: Simmer cauliflower with garlic in milk and water; blend with half the butter and salt.
Pat scallops dry; sear in oil 90 seconds per side.
Wilt spinach in remaining butter; plate purée, spinach, scallops; finish with lemon and chives.

name: Sheet Pan Shrimp Fajitas
steps: Toss shrimp, peppers, onion with oil and spices on a sheet pan.
Roast at 425°F 10–12 minutes.
Squeeze lime; serve in tortillas with avocado and cilantro.

name: Halibut with Lemon Caper Sauce
steps: Season halibut; sear in oil 4 minutes per side.
Add butter, garlic, capers, lemon juice; spoon over fish 1 minute.
Serve with steamed green beans and parsley.

name: Salmon Teriyaki Bowls (No-Sugar)
steps: Simmer tamari, vinegar, ginger, garlic, sweetener, arrowroot slurry into a glaze; add sesame oil.
Broil salmon 8 minutes, brushing with glaze.
Serve over mixed brown and cauliflower rice with steamed broccoli, sesame and green onion.

name: Shrimp Lettuce Wraps with Peanut Sauce
steps: Sauté shrimp with garlic in oil 3 minutes.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, lime, sriracha, water.
Fill lettuce with shrimp, carrot, cucumber, cilantro; drizzle sauce; top peanuts.

name: Mediterranean Baked Tilapia
steps: Place tilapia in a dish; top with tomato, olives, onion, garlic, oregano, oil, lemon.
Bake at 400°F 15–18 minutes.
Top with feta and parsley.

name: Cajun Shrimp & Sausage Skillet
steps: Brown sausage in oil; remove.
Sauté peppers, zucchini, onion, garlic 6 minutes.
Add shrimp and Cajun seasoning; cook 3 minutes; return sausage; finish with lemon.

name: Tuna Steak with Sesame Crust & Slaw
steps: Press tuna into sesame seeds; sear in avocado oil 1–2 minutes per side; slice.
Whisk tamari, sesame oil, vinegar, ginger; toss half with slaw.
Serve tuna over slaw with remaining sauce and green onion.

name: Salmon Cakes with Dill Yogurt
steps: Mix salmon, eggs, almond flour, green onion, Dijon, lemon zest; form 8 cakes.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt, dill, lemon juice; serve cakes over greens.

name: Garlic Shrimp Cauliflower Fried Rice
steps: Sauté shrimp with half the garlic in oil; remove.
Scramble eggs; add carrot, remaining garlic, ginger, cauliflower rice 5 minutes.
Add peas, shrimp, tamari, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Broiled Salmon with Avocado Salsa
steps: Rub salmon with oil, cumin, salt; broil 8–10 minutes.
Dice avocado, tomato, onion, jalapeño; toss with cilantro and lime.
Serve salmon over greens with salsa.

name: Shrimp & Zucchini Pesto Skillet
steps: Sauté zucchini chunks with garlic in oil 4 minutes.
Add shrimp and tomatoes; cook 3 minutes.
Toss with pesto; top parmesan and lemon.

name: Crab Cakes (Almond Flour) with Remoulade
steps: Mix crab, egg, almond flour, half the mayo, Dijon, Old Bay, green onion; form 8 cakes; chill 15 minutes.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt, remaining mayo, chopped pickle, hot sauce, lemon; serve over arugula.

name: Lemon Dill Baked Trout
steps: Lay trout on a pan with broccolini; rub with oil, garlic, salt; top with lemon slices and dill.
Bake at 400°F 12–15 minutes.
Serve with lemon juice.

name: Shrimp Ceviche with Avocado
steps: Poach shrimp 2–3 minutes; chop; chill.
Toss with lime, tomato, onion, cucumber, cilantro, jalapeño, salt; marinate 30 minutes.
Fold in avocado and oil.

name: Sardine & White Bean Salad Plate
ing: Sardines, canned in olive oil, drained
steps: Toss beans, tomato, onion, parsley, capers with lemon and oil.
Plate over arugula.
Top with sardines.

name: Shrimp Pad See Ew (Zoodles)
steps: Stir-fry garlic and shrimp in oil 2 minutes; push aside and scramble eggs.
Add broccolini 2 minutes; add zoodles, tamari, fish sauce, sweetener.
Toss 2 minutes.

name: Salmon with Roasted Brussels & Walnuts
steps: Roast halved sprouts with two-thirds of the oil at 425°F 12 minutes.
Add salmon rubbed with Dijon, garlic, remaining oil; roast 12 minutes more.
Top with walnuts and lemon.

name: Tilapia Veracruz
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, jalapeño in oil; add tomatoes, olives, capers, oregano; simmer 8 minutes.
Nestle tilapia in the sauce; cover; cook 8 minutes.
Serve over cauliflower rice with cilantro.

name: Shrimp Stuffed Avocado Boats
steps: Sauté shrimp in oil 3 minutes; chop; cool.
Mix with yogurt, lime, cilantro, onion, jalapeño, salt.
Fill avocado halves.

name: Baked Cod with Tomato & Olive Tapenade
steps: Pulse olives, sun-dried tomato, capers, garlic, oil into tapenade.
Bake cod at 400°F 12 minutes; top with tapenade last 3 minutes.
Serve with green beans, lemon, basil.

name: Shrimp Egg Roll Bowls
steps: Sauté shrimp with garlic and ginger in oil; remove.
Add slaw, tamari, vinegar; cook 5 minutes; scramble eggs in.
Return shrimp; finish with sesame oil and green onion.

name: Salmon Nicoise Bowl
steps: Roast salmon 12 minutes; blanch green beans; boil eggs.
Whisk oil, Dijon, vinegar.
Arrange greens, salmon, beans, eggs, tomato, olives, capers; drizzle dressing.

name: Spicy Shrimp Lettuce Tacos
steps: Toss shrimp with spices and garlic; sauté in oil 3 minutes.
Fill romaine leaves with shrimp.
Top with pico, avocado, cotija, lime.

name: Mussels in Tomato Garlic Broth
steps: Sauté shallot and garlic in oil; add wine and tomatoes; simmer 5 minutes.
Add mussels; cover; cook 5–6 minutes until open.
Top with parsley, lemon, pepper flakes.

name: Almond-Crusted Tilapia with Green Beans
steps: Pulse almonds with parmesan, garlic powder, paprika; dip fish in egg then crumbs.
Bake at 425°F 12 minutes.
Serve with green beans and lemon.

name: Shrimp & Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Stir-fry broccoli with garlic and ginger in oil 4 minutes; add broth and cover 2 minutes.
Add shrimp; cook 3 minutes.
Add tamari, vinegar, arrowroot slurry, sesame oil; toss; top sesame.

name: Salmon & Quinoa Power Bowl
steps: Roast salmon 12 minutes.
Whisk tahini, lemon, garlic, water; massage half into kale.
Bowl quinoa, kale, cucumber, edamame, avocado, salmon; drizzle remaining dressing.

name: Lobster & Avocado Salad
steps: Mix lobster with celery, chives, lemon, mayo, yogurt, pepper.
Fold in avocado.
Serve in lettuce cups.

name: Blackened Salmon Caesar Bowl
steps: Rub salmon with Cajun seasoning; sear 4 minutes per side.
Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, anchovy, oil.
Toss romaine with dressing; top salmon, parmesan, avocado.

name: Garlic Shrimp with Spaghetti Squash
steps: Roast halved squash 40 minutes; scrape strands.
Sauté garlic in oil and butter; add shrimp 3 minutes; add tomatoes and spinach.
Toss with squash, lemon, parmesan, pepper flakes.

name: Cod en Papillote with Vegetables
steps: Place julienned vegetables on parchment; top with cod, lemon slices, thyme, oil, wine, salt.
Fold parchment into sealed packets.
Bake at 400°F 15–18 minutes; open at the table.

name: Shrimp Sushi Bowls (Cauliflower Rice)
steps: Steam cauliflower rice; season with rice vinegar; cool.
Sauté shrimp 3 minutes.
Bowl with avocado, cucumber, carrot, edamame, nori strips; drizzle tamari and sriracha mayo; sprinkle sesame.

name: Salmon Piccata
steps: Sear salmon in oil 4 minutes per side; remove.
Add garlic, broth, lemon juice, capers; simmer 2 minutes; whisk in butter.
Spoon over salmon; serve with roasted asparagus and parsley.

name: Shrimp & Avocado Cucumber Rolls
steps: Sauté shrimp 3 minutes; chop.
Lay cucumber ribbons overlapping; spread cream cheese; add shrimp and avocado.
Roll tightly; slice; sprinkle sesame and chives; serve with tamari.

name: Swordfish Steaks with Salsa Verde
steps: Blend parsley, capers, anchovy, garlic, lemon, most of the oil, Dijon into salsa verde.
Brush swordfish with remaining oil; grill 4 minutes per side.
Serve over arugula with salsa verde.

name: Shrimp Zucchini Boats
steps: Halve zucchini; scoop centers.
Sauté chopped shrimp with garlic and zucchini flesh; mix with marinara.
Fill boats; top cheeses; bake at 400°F 18 minutes; add basil.

name: Mackerel with Roasted Beets & Mustard Yogurt
steps: Roast beets wrapped in foil 40 minutes; peel and slice.
Broil mackerel with oil and salt 8 minutes.
Mix yogurt, Dijon, dill, lemon; serve fish with beets, greens and sauce.

name: Clams with Garlic, White Wine & Zoodles
steps: Sauté garlic in oil; add wine and clams; cover 5 minutes until open.
Add zoodles; toss 2 minutes.
Finish with parsley, lemon, pepper flakes.

name: Shrimp Cobb Lettuce Wraps
steps: Sauté shrimp; crisp bacon; boil eggs.
Mix yogurt, blue cheese, lemon.
Fill lettuce with shrimp, egg, bacon, avocado, tomato; drizzle.

name: Salmon Stir-Fry with Ginger & Green Beans
steps: Sear salmon cubes in oil 3 minutes; remove.
Stir-fry green beans, pepper, ginger, garlic 4 minutes.
Return salmon with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; top sesame.

name: Fish Curry (Coconut, Kerala-Style)
steps: Sizzle mustard seeds in oil; add onion, garlic, ginger, spices.
Add tomatoes and coconut milk; simmer 8 minutes.
Add cod and spinach; cook 6 minutes; finish with lime, cilantro.

name: Grilled Shrimp Skewers with Chimichurri
steps: Skewer shrimp and zucchini chunks; brush with a third of the oil; grill 3 minutes per side.
Blend remaining oil, herbs, garlic, vinegar, oregano, pepper flakes.
Spoon chimichurri over skewers.

name: Tuna Melt Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve and seed peppers.
Mix tuna, yogurt, Dijon, celery, green onion; fill peppers.
Top with cheddar; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.

name: Salmon Kale Caesar Wrap
steps: Roast salmon; flake.
Toss chopped kale with yogurt, lemon, Dijon, parmesan.
Roll salmon and kale in tortillas.

name: Shrimp Coconut Cauliflower Rice
steps: Sauté cauliflower rice with coconut milk, garlic, ginger 6 minutes.
Sauté shrimp with jalapeño in oil 3 minutes.
Combine; finish with lime, green onion, cilantro.

name: Herb-Crusted Halibut with Ratatouille
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, eggplant, zucchini, pepper in oil 10 minutes; add tomato, thyme; simmer 15 minutes.
Press almond flour-parmesan-basil onto halibut; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.
Serve fish over ratatouille.

name: Shrimp & White Bean Skillet with Spinach
steps: Sauté garlic in oil; add tomatoes 2 minutes.
Add shrimp 3 minutes; add beans and spinach until wilted.
Finish with lemon, parsley, pepper flakes.

name: Salmon Sheet Pan with Broccoli & Sweet Potato
steps: Roast sweet potato cubes with half the oil 15 minutes.
Add broccoli and salmon rubbed with garlic, paprika, remaining oil; roast 15 minutes more.
Finish with lemon.

name: Shrimp Tom Yum-Style Bowl
steps: Simmer broth with lemongrass, ginger, jalapeño 8 minutes.
Add mushrooms and tomato 3 minutes; add shrimp 3 minutes.
Add fish sauce, lime; pour over zoodles; top cilantro.

name: Sea Bass with Fennel & Citrus
steps: Roast sliced fennel with half the oil at 425°F 12 minutes.
Add sea bass, orange slices, olives, garlic, thyme, remaining oil; roast 12 minutes.
Serve with pan juices.

name: Shrimp Cauliflower Grits Bowl with Kale
steps: Blend steamed cauliflower with milk, cheddar, salt.
Sauté kale with half the garlic; sauté shrimp with remaining garlic and Old Bay.
Bowl grits, kale, shrimp; finish lemon, green onion.

name: Salmon Avocado Sushi Stack
steps: Roast or sear salmon; flake. Steam and cool cauliflower rice seasoned with vinegar.
In a ring mold layer cauliflower rice, avocado, cucumber, salmon; unmold.
Top with nori strips, sesame, green onion, tamari, sriracha.

name: Trout Amandine with Green Beans
steps: Sear trout in oil 3 minutes per side; remove.
Toast sliced almonds in butter; add lemon juice and parsley.
Spoon over trout; serve with green beans.

name: Shrimp Fried 'Rice' with Kimchi
steps: Sauté shrimp with garlic in oil; remove.
Stir-fry kimchi and cauliflower rice 5 minutes; scramble eggs in.
Return shrimp with tamari, gochujang, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Cod Cakes with Lemon Dill Sauce
steps: Mix flaked cod, eggs, almond flour, green onion, Dijon, Old Bay; form 8 cakes.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt, dill, lemon; serve cakes over arugula.

name: Shrimp Primavera with Chickpea Pasta
steps: Cook pasta al dente.
Sauté garlic, asparagus, zucchini 4 minutes; add shrimp and tomatoes 3 minutes; add peas.
Toss with pasta, lemon, parmesan, basil.

name: Salmon Poke Lettuce Cups
steps: Cube salmon; toss with tamari, sesame oil, vinegar, green onion.
Fill lettuce cups with poke, avocado, cucumber, seaweed.
Sprinkle sesame.

name: Baked Snapper with Tomatoes & Herbs
steps: Place snapper in a dish with tomatoes, zucchini, garlic; drizzle oil, wine, lemon; season.
Bake at 400°F 15–18 minutes.
Top with basil.

name: Shrimp Caesar Zoodle Bowl
steps: Sauté shrimp 3 minutes.
Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, anchovy, garlic, oil.
Toss zoodles and romaine with dressing; top shrimp and parmesan.

name: Salmon Tacos with Chipotle Yogurt
steps: Rub salmon with spices and oil; broil 8 minutes; flake.
Mix yogurt with minced chipotle and lime.
Fill tortillas with cabbage, salmon, avocado, chipotle yogurt, cilantro.

name: Shrimp Spinach Artichoke Skillet
steps: Sauté shrimp with garlic in oil; remove.
Wilt spinach; add artichokes, cream cheese, yogurt, parmesan; stir until creamy.
Return shrimp; finish with lemon.

name: Grilled Tuna with Avocado & Tomato Salad
steps: Brush tuna with oil; grill 2 minutes per side.
Toss avocado, tomato, onion, basil, capers with lemon and oil.
Slice tuna; serve with salad.

name: Almond-Crusted Catfish with Collards
steps: Simmer collards with onion, garlic, broth, vinegar 20 minutes.
Dip catfish in egg then almond flour-Cajun; pan-fry in oil 4 minutes per side.
Serve with collards and hot sauce.

name: Shrimp & Mango Lettuce Cups
steps: Sauté shrimp with cumin 3 minutes; cool slightly.
Toss with mango, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime, avocado.
Spoon into lettuce cups.

name: Oven-Roasted Sardines with Lemon & Greens
ing: Sardines, canned in olive oil, drained
steps: Rub sardines with oil, garlic, salt; roast at 425°F 10–12 minutes.
Toss arugula and tomato with lemon.
Serve sardines over the salad with parsley.

name: Shrimp Boil Sheet Pan (Low-Carb)
steps: Toss potatoes with half the oil and Old Bay; roast 15 minutes.
Add zucchini, sausage, corn, shrimp, remaining oil, garlic; roast 10 minutes.
Drizzle melted butter and lemon; parsley.

name: Salmon with Cucumber Dill Yogurt
steps: Roast salmon with oil and salt 12 minutes.
Mix yogurt, grated cucumber, dill, garlic, lemon.
Serve salmon over greens with sauce.

name: Scallop & Asparagus Stir-Fry
steps: Sear scallops in oil 90 seconds per side; remove.
Stir-fry asparagus, garlic, ginger 3 minutes.
Return scallops with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; green onion.

name: Chickpea & Spinach Curry
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, spices in oil 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas; simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in spinach; finish lime, cilantro; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Press tofu; cube; toss with arrowroot; pan-fry in oil until crisp; remove.
Stir-fry vegetables, garlic, ginger 5 minutes.
Return tofu with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; top sesame.

name: Black Bean Burgers (Lettuce Bun)
steps: Mash beans; mix with oats, egg, onion, garlic, spices, salt; form 4 patties; chill 15 minutes.
Pan-fry in oil 5 minutes per side.
Serve in lettuce with avocado, tomato, salsa.

name: Lentil Bolognese over Zoodles
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, mushrooms, garlic in oil 8 minutes.
Add wine, tomatoes, lentils, seasoning; simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over sautéed zoodles with parmesan.

name: Eggplant Parmesan (Baked, Almond Crust)
steps: Slice eggplant; salt 15 minutes; blot. Dip in egg then almond flour-parmesan-seasoning; bake at 425°F 20 minutes.
Layer with marinara and mozzarella in a dish.
Bake at 375°F 20 minutes; top basil.

name: Tempeh Taco Bowls
steps: Crumble tempeh; sauté in oil with seasoning and tamari 8 minutes until browned.
Sauté cauliflower rice.
Bowl with beans, pico, avocado, romaine, lime, cilantro.

name: Cauliflower Crust Veggie Pizza
steps: Microwave cauliflower rice 5 minutes; cool; squeeze dry. Mix with eggs, 80 g mozzarella, parmesan, almond flour, seasoning.
Press into a round on parchment; bake at 425°F 20 minutes until golden.
Top with marinara, vegetables, remaining mozzarella; bake 12 minutes; basil.

name: Mushroom & Spinach Stuffed Portobellos with Quinoa
steps: Brush caps with oil and balsamic; roast 8 minutes.
Sauté chopped mushrooms, garlic, spinach; mix with quinoa, walnuts, thyme.
Fill caps; top goat cheese; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.

name: Tofu Coconut Curry
steps: Pan-fry tofu cubes in oil until golden; remove.
Fry curry paste, garlic, ginger; add coconut milk, vegetables; simmer 8 minutes.
Return tofu; add tamari, lime, basil; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Zucchini Noodles with Avocado Pesto & White Beans
steps: Blend avocado, basil, garlic, lemon, oil, pine nuts, salt into pesto.
Warm zoodles 2 minutes; toss with pesto.
Add beans and tomatoes.

name: Shakshuka with Chickpeas
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic with spices in oil 7 minutes.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas, harissa; simmer 10 minutes.
Crack in eggs; cover 7 minutes; top feta, parsley.

name: Greek Stuffed Peppers with Quinoa & Feta
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Mix quinoa, chickpeas, chopped spinach, olives, tomato, garlic, oregano, lemon, oil, half the feta.
Fill peppers; top remaining feta; bake at 400°F 20 minutes.

name: Crispy Baked Tofu with Broccoli & Peanut Sauce
steps: Toss tofu cubes with arrowroot and half the oil; roast at 425°F 25 minutes with broccoli tossed in remaining oil.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, lime, ginger, sriracha, warm water.
Drizzle sauce; top green onion, peanuts.

name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie with Cauliflower Mash
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, mushrooms, garlic; add lentils, tomato paste, broth, thyme, peas; simmer 10 minutes.
Mash steamed cauliflower with butter, milk, parmesan, salt.
Top filling with mash; bake at 400°F 25 minutes.

name: Egg Fried Cauliflower Rice with Edamame
steps: Scramble eggs in oil; remove.
Stir-fry carrot, garlic, ginger, cauliflower rice 5 minutes.
Add edamame, eggs, tamari, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Baked Falafel with Tahini & Cucumber Salad
steps: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, spices, baking powder, almond flour, salt; form 16 balls; brush with oil.
Bake at 425°F 22 minutes, flipping once.
Whisk tahini, lemon, water; serve with cucumber-tomato salad.

name: Spaghetti Squash Primavera
steps: Roast halved squash 40 minutes; scrape.
Sauté garlic and vegetables 5 minutes; add beans.
Toss with squash, lemon, parmesan, basil.

name: Caprese Stuffed Portobellos
steps: Brush caps with oil and garlic; roast 8 minutes.
Fill with halved tomato, mozzarella, beans; bake 10 minutes.
Top basil and balsamic.

name: Tofu Scramble Burrito Bowl
steps: Crumble tofu; sauté with turmeric, cumin, nutritional yeast, pepper 6 minutes.
Sauté cauliflower rice.
Bowl with beans, salsa, avocado, cilantro.

name: Mushroom Lentil Loaf
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, mushrooms, garlic; pulse with lentils, oats, walnuts, eggs, half the tomato paste, tamari, thyme.
Press into a loaf pan; glaze with remaining tomato paste.
Bake at 375°F 50 minutes; rest 10.

name: Edamame & Vegetable Soba Bowl
steps: Cook soba; rinse cold.
Whisk tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, ginger.
Toss soba with edamame, vegetables, dressing; sesame.

name: Zucchini Lasagna with Ricotta & Spinach
steps: Slice zucchini; salt, blot, grill briefly. Sauté mushrooms and garlic; add marinara.
Mix ricotta, egg, spinach, seasoning.
Layer zucchini, ricotta, sauce; top cheeses; bake at 375°F 40 minutes.

name: Cauliflower Tikka Masala
steps: Roast cauliflower florets with half the oil and half the spices at 425°F 20 minutes.
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, remaining spices; add tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes; add coconut milk.
Stir in cauliflower, chickpeas, yogurt; garnish cilantro.

name: Greek Zucchini Fritters with Tzatziki
steps: Grate zucchini; salt; squeeze very dry. Mix with eggs, feta, almond flour, green onion, herbs.
Pan-fry spoonfuls in oil 3 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic; serve.

name: Buddha Bowl with Roasted Chickpeas & Tahini
steps: Roast chickpeas, sweet potato, broccoli with oil, paprika, salt at 425°F 22 minutes.
Whisk tahini, lemon, garlic, water.
Bowl quinoa, kale, cabbage, roasted items, avocado; drizzle tahini.

name: Mushroom Stroganoff (Yogurt) over Zoodles
steps: Sear mushrooms in oil until browned; add onion, garlic, thyme, paprika.
Add broth; reduce; stir in yogurt and Dijon off heat.
Serve over sautéed zoodles with parsley.

name: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Enchilada Skillet
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Sauté diced sweet potato in oil covered 8 minutes; add onion, pepper, garlic, cumin.
Add beans and enchilada sauce; simmer 8 minutes.
Top cheddar; cover to melt; serve with yogurt, avocado, cilantro.

name: Tofu Banh Mi Lettuce Wraps
steps: Marinate tofu slabs in tamari, garlic, five-spice; pan-fry in oil until crisp.
Quick-pickle carrot and daikon in vinegar 15 minutes.
Fill lettuce with tofu, pickles, cucumber, jalapeño, cilantro, sriracha mayo.

name: Ratatouille with White Beans
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add eggplant, pepper 8 minutes.
Add zucchini, tomato, thyme; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in beans; finish basil.

name: Cottage Cheese Egg Bake with Veggies
steps: Whisk eggs with cottage cheese, garlic powder, salt.
Stir in chopped vegetables and half the cheddar; pour into oiled dish.
Top remaining cheddar; bake at 350°F 35–40 minutes.

name: Lentil Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
steps: Sauté onion, garlic; add lentils, seasoning, tomato paste, splash of water; cook 6 minutes.
Toss cabbage with lime and half the yogurt.
Fill tortillas with lentils, slaw, avocado, yogurt, cilantro.

name: Tempeh Stir-Fry with Bok Choy
steps: Pan-fry tempeh slices in oil until golden; remove.
Stir-fry shiitake, garlic, ginger; add bok choy 3 minutes.
Return tempeh with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; sesame.

name: Spinach & Feta Stuffed Mushrooms (Meal-Sized)
steps: Brush caps with oil; roast 8 minutes.
Sauté spinach and garlic; mix with feta, ricotta, dill, beans.
Fill; top pine nuts; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.

name: Quinoa Black Bean Stuffed Zucchini
steps: Halve zucchini; scoop.
Mix quinoa, beans, corn, salsa, cumin, chopped zucchini flesh.
Fill; top cheese; bake at 400°F 25 minutes; cilantro.

name: Egg & Vegetable Curry
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, curry powder in oil.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk, cauliflower, green beans; simmer 15 minutes.
Add halved eggs; warm; garnish cilantro.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Quinoa Bake
steps: Sauté onion and garlic; steam broccoli.
Mix quinoa, broccoli, yogurt, eggs, milk, Dijon, half the cheddar, salt.
Spread in a dish; top cheddar; bake at 375°F 25 minutes.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Skillet with Feta
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add tomatoes, chickpeas, oregano; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in spinach and olives.
Top feta and lemon.

name: Tofu Pad Thai (Zoodles)
steps: Pan-fry tofu cubes until crisp; push aside; scramble eggs.
Add zoodles, garlic, tamari, lime, sweetener, sriracha; toss 2 minutes.
Add sprouts, green onion; top peanuts, cilantro.

name: Cauliflower Fried Rice with Tofu
steps: Pan-fry tofu cubes until golden; remove.
Scramble eggs; add carrot, garlic, ginger, cauliflower rice 5 minutes.
Add peas, tofu, tamari, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Vegetarian Chili-Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Boil whole sweet potatoes 20–25 minutes until tender (boiling keeps the GI far lower than baking).
Sauté onion, pepper, garlic, spices; add beans and tomatoes; simmer 15 minutes.
Split potatoes; fill with chili; top yogurt, cheddar, green onion.

name: Eggplant Rollatini (Ricotta & Spinach)
steps: Slice eggplant lengthwise thin; brush with oil; roast at 425°F 12 minutes until pliable.
Mix ricotta, egg, spinach, parmesan, garlic; spread on slices and roll.
Place in marinara; top mozzarella; bake at 375°F 25 minutes; basil.

name: White Bean & Kale Skillet with Poached Eggs
steps: Sauté garlic and pepper flakes in oil; add tomatoes and beans; simmer 5 minutes.
Add kale until wilted; make wells; crack eggs; cover 6 minutes.
Top parmesan and lemon.

name: Tempeh Bolognese over Chickpea Pasta
steps: Crumble tempeh; brown in oil with onion, carrot, celery, garlic.
Add wine, tomatoes, seasoning; simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over al dente pasta with parmesan.

name: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls with Lentils
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Blanch cabbage leaves. Mix lentils, cauliflower rice, sautéed onion, garlic, walnuts, paprika, salt.
Roll filling in leaves; place in a dish; cover with tomato sauce and tomatoes.
Bake covered at 350°F 60 minutes; dill.

name: Grilled Feta & Veggie Skewers
steps: Thread feta cubes and vegetables on skewers; brush with oil and oregano.
Grill 8–10 minutes, turning gently.
Serve over chickpeas dressed with lemon.

name: Cauliflower Steaks with Chimichurri & White Beans
steps: Cut cauliflower into 1-inch steaks; brush with a third of the oil; roast at 425°F 25 minutes, flipping once.
Blend remaining oil, herbs, garlic, vinegar, oregano, pepper flakes.
Serve steaks over warm beans with chimichurri.

name: Tofu Tikka Masala
steps: Toss tofu cubes with half the yogurt and spices; roast at 425°F 20 minutes.
Sauté onion, ginger, garlic, remaining spices; add tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes; add coconut milk and yogurt.
Add tofu; serve over cauliflower rice with cilantro.

name: Spinach Artichoke Stuffed Spaghetti Squash
steps: Roast halved squash 40 minutes; scrape strands.
Mix strands with sautéed spinach and garlic, artichokes, cream cheese, yogurt, beans, half the cheeses.
Return to shells; top remaining cheese; broil 4 minutes.

name: Moroccan Vegetable Tagine with Chickpeas
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, spices in oil.
Add vegetables, tomatoes, chickpeas, harissa; simmer covered 25 minutes.
Top cilantro and toasted almonds.

name: Egg White Veggie Frittata with Goat Cheese
steps: Sauté asparagus in oil in an ovenproof skillet 4 minutes; add spinach.
Pour in whisked egg whites and eggs with salt; add tomatoes, dot goat cheese.
Bake at 375°F 15 minutes; chives.

name: Peanut Tofu Lettuce Wraps
steps: Crumble tofu; pan-fry in oil 8 minutes until browned.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, lime, sriracha, garlic, water; toss half with tofu.
Fill lettuce; add vegetables; drizzle remaining sauce; peanuts.

name: Greek Lentil Moussaka-Style Bake
steps: Roast eggplant slices with oil 20 minutes.
Simmer lentils with onion, garlic, tomatoes, cinnamon, oregano 10 minutes.
Layer; top yogurt whisked with eggs, parmesan, nutmeg; bake at 375°F 30 minutes.

name: Veggie Burger Bowls with Hummus
steps: Mash chickpeas with oats, egg, garlic, cumin, parsley, salt; form patties; pan-fry 5 minutes per side.
Bowl greens, cucumber, tomato, olives.
Add patties and hummus; lemon.

name: Tofu & Vegetable Skewers with Chimichurri
steps: Thread pressed tofu and vegetables; brush with a third of the oil; grill 10–12 minutes.
Blend remaining oil, herbs, garlic, vinegar, oregano, salt.
Spoon over skewers.

name: Cabbage & Mushroom Stir-Fry with Eggs
steps: Scramble eggs in oil; remove.
Stir-fry mushrooms until browned; add garlic, ginger, cabbage 5 minutes.
Return eggs; add tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, green onion, chili crisp.

name: Mediterranean Baked Feta with Chickpeas & Tomatoes
steps: Place feta in a dish surrounded by tomatoes, chickpeas, olives, garlic; drizzle oil, oregano, pepper flakes.
Bake at 400°F 25 minutes until tomatoes burst.
Stir in spinach and basil; mash feta into the sauce.

name: Edamame Fried Cauliflower Rice
steps: Scramble eggs; remove.
Stir-fry carrot, garlic, ginger, cauliflower rice 5 minutes; add edamame.
Return eggs; add tamari, sesame oil, green onion, torn nori.

name: Zucchini & Corn Fritters with Yogurt
steps: Grate zucchini; salt; squeeze dry; mix with corn, eggs, almond flour, parmesan, green onion.
Pan-fry spoonfuls in oil 3 minutes per side.
Serve with yogurt, lime, cilantro.

name: Portobello 'Steaks' with Cauliflower Mash
steps: Marinate caps in balsamic, tamari, garlic, half the oil; roast at 425°F 18 minutes.
Mash steamed cauliflower with butter, milk, parmesan, salt.
Serve mushrooms over mash with warm beans and thyme.

name: Thai Peanut Tempeh Bowls
steps: Pan-fry tempeh cubes in oil; steam broccoli.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, lime, ginger, sriracha, water.
Bowl cauliflower rice, vegetables, tempeh; sauce; peanuts.

name: Caprese Zucchini Noodle Bowl with Chickpeas
steps: Warm zoodles with garlic in oil 2 minutes.
Toss with chickpeas, tomato, mozzarella.
Balsamic, basil, salt.

name: Black Bean Enchilada Casserole (Low-Carb Tortillas)
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, cumin; mix with beans, corn, chiles.
Layer tortillas, filling, sauce, cheese.
Bake at 375°F 25 minutes; yogurt, cilantro.

name: Miso Glazed Eggplant with Edamame
steps: Halve eggplants; score; brush with avocado oil; roast at 425°F 20 minutes.
Whisk miso, tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, sweetener; brush on; broil 3 minutes.
Serve with edamame, green onion, sesame.

name: Egg Roll Bowl with Tofu
steps: Crumble tofu; brown in oil 8 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, slaw, tamari, vinegar; cook 5 minutes.
Sesame oil, green onion, sriracha.

name: Roasted Vegetable & Goat Cheese Frittata
steps: Roast vegetables with oil at 425°F 15 minutes.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt; pour over vegetables in an ovenproof skillet; dot goat cheese, thyme.
Bake at 375°F 18 minutes.

name: Chickpea 'Tuna' Salad Lettuce Wraps
steps: Mash chickpeas roughly.
Mix with celery, onion, pickle, mayo, yogurt, Dijon, lemon, crumbled nori, dill.
Serve in lettuce cups.

name: Loaded Cauliflower Casserole
steps: Steam cauliflower; chop.
Mix yogurt, cream cheese, eggs, garlic powder, half the cheddar, salt; fold in cauliflower.
Top cheddar; bake at 375°F 25 minutes; green onion.

name: Sesame Tofu Noodle Bowl (Shirataki)
steps: Pan-fry tofu until crisp.
Rinse and dry-fry shirataki; stir-fry vegetables 3 minutes.
Whisk tahini, tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, water; toss everything; sesame.

name: Chipotle Black Bean Lettuce Tacos
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, cumin; add beans, chipotle, splash of water; mash lightly; cook 6 minutes.
Fill romaine leaves.
Top avocado, pico, cotija, cilantro, lime.

name: Spinach Ricotta Stuffed Zucchini Boats
steps: Halve zucchini; scoop.
Mix ricotta, spinach, egg, parmesan, garlic, nutmeg, salt; fill.
Spoon marinara over; top mozzarella; bake at 400°F 25 minutes.

name: Lentil Sloppy Joes (Lettuce or Muffin)
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic in oil.
Add lentils, sauce, paste, vinegar, Dijon, paprika, sweetener; simmer 10 minutes.
Serve on toasted muffin halves or lettuce.

name: Tofu Shakshuka
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic, spices in oil.
Add tomatoes and harissa; simmer 10 minutes.
Nestle tofu slabs into the sauce; cover 8 minutes; parsley.

name: Broccoli Tofu Stir-Fry with Garlic Sauce
steps: Pan-fry tofu cubes until golden; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli, garlic, ginger; add broth, cover 2 minutes.
Add tamari, vinegar, arrowroot slurry, sesame oil, tofu, pepper flakes.

name: Greek Chickpea Stuffed Eggplant
steps: Score and roast eggplant halves with half the oil at 400°F 25 minutes; scoop flesh.
Sauté onion, garlic, flesh, tomato, chickpeas, oregano, cinnamon.
Refill shells; top feta; bake 15 minutes; parsley.

name: Cauliflower Mac & Cheese (Chickpea Pasta)
steps: Cook pasta al dente; steam cauliflower.
Blend half the cauliflower with milk, cream cheese, Dijon, garlic powder, nutritional yeast, salt; warm with cheddar.
Toss with pasta and remaining florets.

name: Tempeh 'Sausage' & Peppers
steps: Crumble tempeh; sauté in oil with seasoning, fennel, paprika, tamari until browned.
Add peppers, onion, garlic; cook 8 minutes; add marinara.
Simmer 5 minutes; parmesan.

name: Herbed Cottage Cheese Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Mix cottage cheese, eggs, spinach, parmesan, herbs, garlic, salt; fill.
Top tomato; bake at 375°F 20 minutes until set.

name: Cuban Black Beans with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic, spices in oil.
Add beans, broth, bay; simmer 15 minutes; mash some; add vinegar.
Serve over cauliflower rice with avocado, cilantro.

name: Roasted Veggie Hummus Bowl
steps: Roast cauliflower, broccoli, pepper, onion, chickpeas with oil and za'atar at 425°F 22 minutes.
Spread hummus in bowls.
Top roasted vegetables, cucumber, tomato, lemon, parsley.

name: Deviled Eggs (Greek Yogurt)
steps: Hard-boil eggs; cool; halve; remove yolks.
Mash yolks with yogurt, mayo, Dijon, salt.
Pipe into whites; paprika, chives.

name: Roasted Chickpeas (Smoky)
steps: Pat chickpeas very dry.
Toss with oil, spices, salt.
Roast at 400°F 30–35 minutes, shaking twice; cool to crisp.

name: Cucumber Hummus Bites
steps: Slice cucumber into thick rounds.
Top each with hummus and a tomato half.
Sprinkle za'atar; drizzle oil.

name: Greek Yogurt Ranch Dip with Veggies
steps: Mix yogurt, ranch seasoning, lemon, chives.
Cut vegetables into sticks.
Serve together.

name: Turkey Roll-Ups with Avocado
steps: Spread turkey slices with cream cheese.
Add avocado and cucumber sticks.
Roll; sprinkle seasoning.

name: Cottage Cheese with Everything Seasoning & Tomatoes
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with halved tomatoes.
Seasoning and oil.

name: Apple Slices with Almond Butter & Cinnamon
steps: Slice apple.
Spread or dip in almond butter.
Sprinkle cinnamon and hemp seeds.

name: Spicy Edamame
steps: Boil or steam edamame pods 4 minutes.
Toss with tamari, sesame oil, garlic, pepper flakes.
Sesame seeds.

name: Caprese Skewers
steps: Thread tomato, mozzarella, basil onto picks.
Drizzle balsamic and oil.
Serve.

name: Smoked Salmon Cucumber Rounds
steps: Slice cucumber into rounds.
Top with cream cheese and salmon.
Dill, capers, lemon zest.

name: Guacamole with Jicama Chips
steps: Mash avocado with lime, salt.
Fold in onion, cilantro, jalapeño, tomato.
Serve with jicama sticks.

name: Hard-Boiled Eggs with Everything Seasoning
steps: Boil eggs 9–10 minutes; cool in ice water.
Peel and halve.
Sprinkle seasoning; dash hot sauce.

name: Trail Mix (No Added Sugar)
steps: Combine nuts and seeds.
Add coconut and chopped dark chocolate.
Portion into 40 g servings.

name: Celery with Peanut Butter
steps: Cut celery into sticks.
Fill with peanut butter.
Sprinkle chia.

name: Baked Zucchini Chips with Parmesan
steps: Slice zucchini thin; blot dry.
Toss with oil, parmesan, seasonings.
Bake on racks at 400°F 25–30 minutes until crisp.

name: Shrimp Cocktail with Avocado
steps: Poach shrimp with Old Bay 3 minutes; chill.
Mix tomato paste, hot sauce, lemon, Dijon, a little water for cocktail sauce.
Serve shrimp with sauce and avocado slices.

name: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites
steps: Toss florets with oil and garlic powder; roast at 425°F 22 minutes.
Toss in hot sauce melted with butter; roast 6 minutes.
Serve with yogurt-blue cheese dip and celery.

name: Greek Yogurt with Berries & Chia
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top berries and chia.
Cinnamon.

name: Tuna Cucumber Boats
steps: Halve cucumber lengthwise; scoop seeds.
Mix tuna, yogurt, Dijon, celery, dill, lemon.
Fill boats.

name: Stuffed Mini Peppers with Herbed Goat Cheese
steps: Halve and seed mini peppers.
Mix goat cheese, yogurt, herbs, garlic, pepper.
Pipe into peppers.

name: Kale Chips
steps: Tear kale; dry thoroughly; massage with oil.
Sprinkle nutritional yeast, salt, paprika.
Bake at 300°F 12–15 minutes until crisp.

name: Cheese & Nut Snack Plate
steps: Slice cheese and cucumber.
Arrange with almonds, olives, pickle.
Serve.

name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients into a stiff dough, adding almond milk as needed.
Roll into 16 balls.
Chill 30 minutes; store refrigerated up to 1 week.

name: Cinnamon Roasted Almonds
steps: Whisk egg white with vanilla; toss almonds to coat.
Toss with cinnamon, sweetener, salt.
Bake at 325°F 15 minutes; cool.

name: Egg Salad Cucumber Cups
steps: Hard-boil and chop eggs; mix with yogurt, Dijon, chives, salt.
Cut cucumber into thick rounds; scoop centers.
Fill; paprika.

name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Asparagus
steps: Wrap 2–3 spears in half a prosciutto slice.
Brush with oil; roast at 425°F 10–12 minutes.
Parmesan, pepper.

name: Spinach Artichoke Dip (Yogurt) with Veggies
steps: Wilt spinach; squeeze dry; chop artichokes.
Mix with yogurt, cream cheese, half the cheeses, garlic, salt; top remaining cheese.
Bake at 375°F 18 minutes; serve with vegetable dippers.

name: Avocado Deviled Eggs
steps: Hard-boil eggs; halve; remove yolks.
Mash yolks with avocado, lime, cilantro, jalapeño, salt.
Fill whites; paprika.

name: Nori Wraps with Tuna & Avocado
steps: Mix tuna with mayo and sriracha.
Lay on nori with avocado and cucumber.
Roll; slice; sesame.

name: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds with Chili Lime
steps: Toss seeds with oil, chili powder, lime zest, salt.
Roast at 325°F 15 minutes, stirring once.
Cool.

name: Turkey & Cheese Lettuce Roll
steps: Layer turkey and cheese on romaine leaves.
Add Dijon and tomato.
Roll and eat.

name: Ricotta & Berry Bowl
steps: Whisk ricotta with vanilla and stevia.
Top raspberries.
Almonds.

name: Baba Ganoush with Vegetable Dippers
steps: Roast whole eggplants at 425°F 40 minutes; cool; scoop flesh.
Blend with tahini, lemon, garlic, half the oil, cumin, salt.
Drizzle oil, parsley; serve with vegetables.

name: Mozzarella & Tomato Bites with Pesto
steps: Halve tomatoes; cube mozzarella.
Toss with pesto.
Basil.

name: Cottage Cheese Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
steps: Slice tops off tomatoes; scoop seeds.
Mix cottage cheese with herbs and pepper.
Fill tomatoes.

name: Seaweed Snack & Edamame Plate
steps: Steam edamame 4 minutes.
Plate with roasted seaweed.
Tamari, sesame.

name: Pizza Cucumber Bites
steps: Slice cucumber into rounds.
Top with marinara, mozzarella, olives, seasoning.
Broil 2–3 minutes.

name: Almond Flour Crackers with Cheese
steps: Mix almond flour, egg, parmesan, rosemary, salt into a dough; roll thin between parchment.
Cut into squares; bake at 350°F 12–15 minutes.
Serve with cheddar slices.

name: Peanut Butter Yogurt Dip with Apple
steps: Whisk yogurt, peanut butter, cinnamon, vanilla.
Slice apple.
Dip.

name: Salmon Salad Romaine Boats
steps: Mix salmon, yogurt, dill, lemon, celery, capers.
Spoon into romaine leaves.
Serve.

name: Baked Parmesan Crisps
steps: Spoon tablespoon mounds of parmesan on parchment.
Sprinkle pepper and seasoning.
Bake at 400°F 5–6 minutes until golden; cool to crisp.

name: Jalapeño Poppers (Baked, Turkey Bacon)
steps: Halve and seed jalapeños.
Mix cream cheese, cheddar, garlic powder; fill peppers; wrap each in half a slice of turkey bacon.
Bake at 400°F 18–20 minutes; green onion.

name: Chia Pudding Snack Cups
steps: Whisk chia, milk, vanilla, sweetener.
Divide into 4 jars; refrigerate overnight.
Top blueberries.

name: Cauliflower Hummus
steps: Roast cauliflower with half the oil at 425°F 20 minutes.
Blend with tahini, lemon, garlic, remaining oil, cumin, salt until smooth.
Paprika; serve with vegetables.

name: Turkey Meatball Snack Skewers
steps: Mix turkey, egg, almond flour, garlic, oregano, feta, salt; form small meatballs; bake at 400°F 18 minutes.
Thread meatballs with tomato and cucumber onto picks.
Serve with yogurt-dill dip.

name: Cucumber Avocado Sushi Bites
steps: Cut cucumber into thick rounds; scoop centers.
Fill with mashed avocado and a piece of salmon.
Nori strip, sesame, tamari.

name: Crunchy Roasted Edamame
steps: Pat shelled edamame dry; toss with oil and spices.
Roast at 400°F 25–30 minutes until crunchy.
Cool.

name: Mini Frittata Bites (Spinach & Feta)
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, salt; stir in spinach, feta, green onion, dill.
Pour into oiled mini muffin cups.
Bake at 350°F 15–18 minutes.

name: Cheese-Stuffed Olives & Cucumber Plate
steps: Arrange olives, feta, cucumber and tomato on a plate.
Drizzle oil.
Oregano.

name: Peanut Butter Celery Boats with Hemp
steps: Cut celery into boats.
Fill with peanut butter.
Hemp seeds, cinnamon.

name: Greek Yogurt Tzatziki with Veggie Sticks
steps: Grate cucumber; squeeze dry.
Mix with yogurt, garlic, dill, lemon, oil, salt.
Serve with vegetable sticks.

name: Roasted Seaweed Tuna Salad Cups
steps: Mix tuna, mayo, sriracha, green onion.
Spoon onto seaweed sheets with cucumber.
Fold and eat.

name: Cottage Cheese Protein Bowl with Pistachios
